subquestions.question: Will Russian forces capture or establish confirmed control over the eastern outskirts of Myrnohrad (east of the railway line running through the city) by September 21, 2025, according to the ISW map?
subquestions.background_information:
Myrnohrad is a city in the Donetsk Oblast of Ukraine, located along the strategic Pokrovsk–Kramatorsk corridor. As of late August 2025, Russian forces have been advancing toward Myrnohrad from the east, capturing positions at the Oksamyt wastewater plant, pushing toward Mine No. 1 'Oksamyt,' and expanding their area of control east of Myrnohrad. The specific intersection in the ultimate question (Vatutina Vulytsya and Puhachova Vulytsya) is located in the central-western part of Myrnohrad, meaning Russian forces would need to push through the eastern neighborhoods and cross significant urban terrain before reaching it.

A key geographic feature is the railway line running roughly north-south through Myrnohrad, which serves as a natural defensive barrier. The eastern outskirts include industrial areas and the approaches from Novoekonomichne and the mine complex areas where fighting has been concentrated. According to ISW reporting from August 25, 2025, Russian commanders have shifted focus from the Dobropillya salient toward Pokrovsk and Myrnohrad. Ukrainian forces have been withdrawing westward under drone and artillery fire.

As of September 1, 2025, the ISW map shows Russian-controlled territory approaching but not yet within the built-up urban area of Myrnohrad proper. The DeepState map corroborates that Russian positions are on the eastern approaches.

Sources:
- ISW Ukraine interactive map: https://storymaps.arcgis.com/stories/36a7f6a6f5a9448496de641cf64bd375
- DeepState Map: https://deepstatemap.live/
- AGC News, August 31, 2025: https://agcnews.eu/ukrainerussiawar-moscow-advances-on-kiev-and-front-expands-in-favor-of-russians-at-myrnohrad/
- ISW assessment, August 25, 2025: https://www.understandingwar.org/
subquestions.resolution_criteria: This question resolves Yes if, at any point between 2025-09-01 and 2025-09-21 (inclusive), the ISW interactive Ukraine conflict map (https://storymaps.arcgis.com/stories/36a7f6a6f5a9448496de641cf64bd375) shows Russian-controlled territory (shaded red) extending into the built-up urban area of Myrnohrad east of the railway line that runs roughly north-south through the city. Specifically, the red shading must cover any residential or urban blocks east of the railway and west of the city's eastern municipal boundary — i.e., Russian forces must have entered the urban fabric of Myrnohrad itself, not merely the industrial or mine complex areas on the outskirts. If the ISW map becomes unavailable, the DeepState Map (https://deepstatemap.live/) may be used as an alternative. Temporary map glitches do not count. The question resolves No if no such red shading appears on the map by 2025-09-21 at 11:59 PM ET.
subquestions.rationale: Capturing the Vatutina/Puhachova intersection in central-western Myrnohrad by September 30 requires Russian forces to first penetrate the eastern urban areas of the city. The railway line through Myrnohrad is a significant intermediate defensive barrier. If Russian forces have not even entered the eastern urban area by September 21, it becomes extremely unlikely they could advance several more kilometers through urban terrain to reach the central intersection by September 30. Conversely, if they have already breached the eastern urban perimeter by September 21, the probability of reaching the target intersection rises substantially. This subquestion thus serves as a meaningful leading indicator — it tracks a necessary precursor step rather than simply restating the ultimate question with an earlier deadline.

question: Will Ghislaine Maxwell testify before Congress in 2025?
description:

subquestions.question: Will the U.S. Supreme Court act on Ghislaine Maxwell's certiorari petition (grant, deny, or otherwise dispose of it) between 2025-10-01 and 2025-10-31?
subquestions.background_information:
Ghislaine Maxwell is currently serving a 20-year prison sentence for sex trafficking. She has been subpoenaed by the House Oversight Committee to testify, but her attorneys have demanded that any testimony be scheduled after the resolution of her Supreme Court petition and her forthcoming habeas petition. Maxwell's legal team has argued that testifying while her appeal is pending could compromise her constitutional rights, prejudice her legal claims, and potentially taint a future jury pool. If these demands are not met, her attorneys have stated she will invoke her Fifth Amendment rights and decline to answer questions.

The Supreme Court's October 2025 term begins on October 6, 2025, and the Court regularly issues orders on pending certiorari petitions during its conference sessions throughout the term. If the Supreme Court denies Maxwell's cert petition in October, one of the key conditions her attorneys set for testimony would be resolved, potentially clearing the path for her to testify before Congress before year-end. Conversely, if the Court grants certiorari, further litigation could delay or prevent testimony entirely. If no action is taken in October, the standoff between Maxwell's legal team and the Oversight Committee is likely to continue.

Sources:
- CNN: Maxwell offers to testify before Congress but with major conditions, including immunity — https://www.cnn.com/2025/07/29/politics/ghislaine-maxwell-congress-testimony-conditions/index.html
- ABC17NEWS: Maxwell offers to testify before Congress but with major conditions — https://www.abc17news.com/news/national/2025/07/29/maxwell-offers-to-testify-before-congress-but-with-major-conditions-including-immunity/
- Supreme Court October Term 2025 calendar — https://www.supremecourt.gov/oral_arguments/calendarsandlists.aspx
- The Gateway Pundit: Ghislaine Maxwell Demands Immunity to Testify Before House Oversight Committee — https://www.thegatewaypundit.com/2025/07/ghislaine-maxwell-demands-immunity-testify-before-house-oversight/
subquestions.resolution_criteria: This question resolves Yes if, between 2025-10-01 and 2025-10-31 (inclusive), the U.S. Supreme Court takes a dispositive action on Ghislaine Maxwell's petition for a writ of certiorari related to her 2021 sex-trafficking conviction. Dispositive actions include: granting certiorari, denying certiorari, or dismissing the petition. The resolution source will be the Supreme Court's official orders list, available at https://www.supremecourt.gov/orders/ordersofthecourt.aspx, or credible legal news reporting (e.g., SCOTUSblog at https://www.scotusblog.com/, Reuters, AP). If no such action is taken by the Court during this window, or if Maxwell has not yet filed a certiorari petition by October 31, 2025, this question resolves No.
subquestions.rationale: Maxwell's attorneys explicitly conditioned her testimony before Congress on the resolution of her Supreme Court petition. If the Court acts on the petition in October — particularly by denying cert — it removes a major obstacle her legal team cited for refusing to testify, making congressional testimony before year-end substantially more likely. If the Court grants cert, extended litigation would make 2025 testimony very unlikely. The Supreme Court's action (or inaction) on this petition is therefore one of the most informative near-term indicators for whether Maxwell will ultimately testify before Congress in 2025.

subquestions.question: Will the U.S. publicly issue an explicit military threat (beyond existing rhetoric) against Colombia, Mexico, Cuba, or Iran between January 6, 2026, and January 31, 2026?
subquestions.background_information:
On January 3, 2026, the U.S. launched 'Operation Absolute Resolve,' a military strike on Venezuela that resulted in the capture of President Nicolás Maduro. In the immediate aftermath, President Trump made threatening remarks toward several other countries. He suggested potential 'Operation Colombia,' called Colombia 'very sick,' said Cuba is 'ready to fall,' threatened military entry into Mexico, and warned Iran of potential Israeli military action backed by the U.S. if it resumes nuclear activities. Colombia's President Petro warned that any U.S. attack on its sovereignty would be treated as a declaration of war, while Mexico's President Sheinbaum declined to schedule a call with Trump after his threats. Cuba's President Díaz-Canel called the Venezuela operation a 'criminal US attack.' As of January 5, 2026, these remain rhetorical threats, but the precedent set by the Venezuela strike has raised the plausibility of follow-on actions. A new explicit military threat — such as an official order to prepare military options, a formal ultimatum with a deadline, deployment of additional forces to a staging area near one of these countries, or a presidential directive publicly announced — would be a significant escalation beyond the current rhetorical posture and a meaningful indicator of whether an actual strike could follow before March 31, 2026.

Sources:
- Yahoo News, 'World reaction to U.S. strikes on Venezuela pours in' (Jan 4, 2026): https://www.yahoo.com/news/world-reaction-us-strikes-venezuela-pours-in.html
- Zero Hedge / Newsquawk, 'Crude falls following US strike on Venezuela' (Jan 5, 2026): https://www.zerohedge.com/markets/crude-falls-following-us-strike-venezuela-european-equity-futures-point-positive-open

This question resolves Yes if, between January 6, 2026, and January 31, 2026 (inclusive), the U.S. government issues a new, explicit military threat against Colombia, Mexico, Cuba, or Iran that goes beyond the rhetorical statements already made as of January 5, 2026. Qualifying escalations include any of the following, as reported by at least two major credible English-language news outlets (e.g., Reuters, AP, BBC, NYT, Washington Post, CNN, The Guardian):

1. A formal presidential or Secretary of Defense public statement announcing the preparation or authorization of military options against one of these countries (e.g., 'I have ordered the Pentagon to prepare strike plans for Colombia');
2. A publicly announced deployment of additional U.S. military assets (carrier strike groups, bomber wings, troop deployments) to staging areas specifically stated to be for potential operations against one of these countries;
3. A formal public ultimatum with a specific deadline directed at one of these countries, threatening military action if demands are not met;
4. An official executive order or National Security Council directive, made public, authorizing planning for strikes on one of these countries.

General rhetorical threats, social media posts repeating prior rhetoric, or vague warnings that do not represent a concrete new escalation beyond the January 3-5 statements do not qualify. The question resolves No if no such qualifying escalation is reported by January 31, 2026.

- Reuters: https://www.reuters.com
- Associated Press: https://apnews.com
- BBC News: https://www.bbc.com/news

subquestions.rationale: The ultimate question asks whether the U.S. will strike Venezuela again or strike Iran, Colombia, Mexico, or Cuba before March 31, 2026. The Venezuela operation already occurred, and Trump has made rhetorical threats against all four remaining countries. A key leading indicator of whether rhetoric will turn into action is whether the U.S. escalates from general threats to concrete military preparations or formal ultimatums. If forecasters observe a concrete new military threat by the end of January, they should significantly update toward a strike occurring before March 31. If no escalation beyond current rhetoric occurs, this suggests the threats may remain bluster, updating toward 'Yes' (nothing happens) on the ultimate question. This subquestion captures a different observable — escalation of threat posture — rather than simply asking about strikes with an earlier deadline.

question: Nikita Bier out as Head of Product at X by December 31?
description:
This market will resolve to "Yes" if Nikita Bier ceases to be Head of Product of X for any length of time between October 14, and December 31, 2025 ET. Otherwise, this market will resolve to "No".

An announcement of Nikita Bier's resignation/firing before this market's end date will immediately resolve this market to "Yes", regardless of when the announced resignation/firing goes into effect.

This market's primary resolution source will be official information from X and/or Nikita Bier, however a consensus of credible reporting will also be used.

subquestions.question: Will Nikita Bier post on his X account (@nikitabier) at least 10 times between October 15 and November 14, 2025, with at least one post referencing his role or work at X?
subquestions.background_information:
Nikita Bier was appointed Head of Product at X in late June/early July 2025. He is an extremely prolific poster on the platform, frequently discussing product changes, anti-spam initiatives, and user engagement strategies in his official capacity. In September 2025, he publicly announced the suspension of half a million bot accounts and shared a 'playbook' for users to earn money on X. In July 2025, shortly after his appointment, rumors circulated that he had been fired after a controversial tweet about AI research and a dating show, though this was never confirmed and he continued in the role.

Bier's continued active posting about X product matters is a strong signal that he remains in his role. A sudden silence or absence of work-related posts would be an early indicator that something has changed — either a departure, a reduced role, or internal conflict. Conversely, continued engagement about X's product direction signals stability in his position.

As of mid-October 2025, Bier remains Head of Product at X based on his latest public activity.

Sources:
- Business Insider, "X's new head of product said he got the job by posting his way to the top" (2025-07-01): https://www.businessinsider.com/x-head-product-nikita-bier-posting-elon-musk-2025-7
- Mashable India, "'Time To Meet God' Twitter Product Head Announces Suspension Of Half Million Bot Accounts" (2025-09-17): https://in.mashable.com/tech/87654/time-to-meet-god-twitter-product-head-announces-suspension-of-half-million-bot-accounts-on-x-with-a-meme
- Futurism, "Before Grok's HitlerGate Debacle, X's Head of Product Tweeted Something Absolutely Wild" (2025-07-09): https://futurism.com/the-byte/x-head-product-tweet-grok-nazi
- Business Insider, "X's head of product says this is the playbook for getting rich by posting" (2025-09-05): https://www.businessinsider.com/x-head-product-nikita-bier-playbook-getting-rich-posting-2025-9
subquestions.resolution_criteria:
This question resolves Yes if, between 2025-10-15 and 2025-11-14 (inclusive), Nikita Bier's X account (@nikitabier, https://x.com/nikitabier) has posted at least 10 times total during this window, AND at least one of those posts references his work at X, X's product, or his role at X (e.g., mentions product changes, features, anti-spam efforts, user engagement initiatives, or otherwise implies he is actively working at X in a product leadership capacity). Posts include original tweets, quote tweets, and threads initiated by Bier, but do not include simple retweets without added commentary.

This question resolves No if fewer than 10 posts are made by the account during this window, OR if none of the posts reference his work or role at X.

If the @nikitabier account is deleted, suspended, or made private during the resolution window such that posts cannot be verified, and no archived evidence (e.g., via Wayback Machine at https://web.archive.org/) confirms at least 10 posts with at least one work-related post, the question resolves No.

Resolution is based on a manual check of the @nikitabier X account on or shortly after 2025-11-14.
subquestions.rationale: Nikita Bier is known as an extremely active poster on X, and he frequently discusses his product work publicly. His continued active posting about X product initiatives is a strong behavioral signal that he remains in his role as Head of Product. If Bier were to be fired or resign (or be in the process of doing so), one of the earliest observable signs would likely be a sharp drop in posting frequency or a cessation of posts referencing his role at X. This subquestion tracks an observable behavioral indicator — his public activity pattern — rather than simply asking about his employment status with an earlier deadline. If this question resolves No (he goes quiet or stops referencing X work), it would be a meaningful update toward the ultimate question resolving Yes (departure). If it resolves Yes (he remains active and engaged), it reduces the probability of an imminent departure.

question: Will Giannis Antetokounmpo be traded this season?
description:
This market will resolve to "Yes" if the listed NBA player is traded from their current team to another NBA team before the 2025-2026 NBA trade deadline. Otherwise, this market will resolve to "No".

The NBA trade deadline for the 2025-2026 season is scheduled for February 5, 2026.

The resolution source for this market will be official information from the NBA; however a consensus of credible reporting may also be used.

subquestions.question: Will Giannis Antetokounmpo formally request a trade from the Milwaukee Bucks before January 4, 2026?
subquestions.background_information:
As of early December 2025, Giannis Antetokounmpo and his agent Alex Saratsis have initiated discussions with the Milwaukee Bucks about his future, with ESPN's Shams Charania reporting that 'the writing's on the wall on what's to come with Giannis Antetokounmpo.' The Bucks have started the 2025-26 season with a 9-13 record, losing 12 of their last 17 games. Antetokounmpo removed nearly all Bucks-related content from his social media profiles on December 2, 2025, changing his bio to 'athlete' and featuring Greek national team imagery — a move widely interpreted as a signal of dissatisfaction. ESPN's Brian Windhorst expects Antetokounmpo to provide the Bucks with a trade list. Antetokounmpo holds a no-trade clause and a player option through 2027, giving him significant leverage. The Bucks have stated they will not initiate a trade unless Giannis requests one. Multiple league insiders believe a resolution — either recommitment or a trade demand — is imminent, potentially within weeks. Giannis previously indicated a preference for the New York Knicks, with clandestine discussions occurring in August 2025. The NBA trade deadline is February 5, 2026.

Sources:
- ESPN via Real GM: https://basketball.realgm.com/wiretap/281678/Giannis-Antetokounmpo-Opens-Talks-With-Bucks-About-His-Future
- New York Post: https://nypost.com/2025/12/03/sports/giannis-antetokounmpo-milwaukee-bucks-are-playing-a-game-of-chicken/
- Times of India: https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/sports/nba/top-stories/giannis-antetokounmpo-fuels-blockbuster-trade-speculations/articleshow/116024567.cms
- EssentiallySports: https://www.essentiallysports.com/nba-basketball-news-is-giannis-antetokounmpo-traded-to-the-knicks-fact-checking-viral-post-after-social-media-move/
subquestions.resolution_criteria: This question resolves Yes if, between 2025-12-04 and 2026-01-03 (inclusive), credible reporting from at least two major sports news outlets (e.g., ESPN, The Athletic, Shams Charania, Adrian Wojnarowski, or equivalent tier-one NBA reporters) confirms that Giannis Antetokounmpo has formally requested a trade from the Milwaukee Bucks. A 'formal trade request' means that Antetokounmpo or his representatives have explicitly communicated to the Bucks organization that he wants to be traded, as reported by credible sources. Mere speculation, social media activity, or vague reports of 'discussions about his future' do not count — the reports must specifically characterize the communication as a trade request or trade demand. If no such reports emerge by end of day (11:59 PM ET) on January 3, 2026, this resolves No. Key sources to monitor include ESPN (https://www.espn.com/nba/), The Athletic (https://theathletic.com/nba/), and NBA.com (https://www.nba.com/news).
subquestions.rationale: A formal trade request from Giannis is the single most important prerequisite for a trade actually happening before the February 5, 2026 deadline. The Bucks have repeatedly stated they will not trade him unless he asks for it, and he holds a no-trade clause giving him veto power over any deal. If he formally requests a trade by early January, the probability of a completed trade before the deadline rises dramatically, as it gives the Bucks roughly a month to negotiate. If no request materializes by then, the window for completing a deal becomes much tighter and the probability drops significantly. This subquestion tracks a distinct, observable precursor event rather than simply asking about the trade itself on an earlier timeline.

question: Will Amazon acquire Warner Bros. Discovery?
description:
This market will resolve to "Yes" if it is announced that Warner Bros. Discovery will be, has been, or is being acquired by or merged with the listed entity by 11:59 PM ET on May 31, 2026. Otherwise, this market will resolve to "No".

If no merger or acquisition takes place by the specified date, this market will resolve to "No Acquisition by May 31, 2026".

An official announcement will qualify for a "Yes" resolution, regardless of whether the merger or acquisition is ultimately completed. 

Any merger or acquisition will qualify regardless of whether it regards Warner Bros Discovery's entire company or separate transactions for its Warner Bros. or Discovery Global businesses.

The primary resolution source for this market is official information from the listed individual and/or Warner Bros. Discovery; however, a consensus of credible reporting will also be used.

subquestions.question: Will Amazon publicly confirm it has submitted or is preparing a formal bid or expression of interest to acquire all or part of Warner Bros. Discovery by November 23, 2025?
subquestions.background_information:
Warner Bros. Discovery (WBD) formally announced on October 21, 2025, that it is conducting a strategic review of alternatives after receiving unsolicited acquisition interest from multiple parties. The company has engaged financial advisors Allen & Company, J.P. Morgan, and Evercore, along with legal counsel, to evaluate options including a full company sale, partial sales, or mergers. Paramount Skydance, led by David Ellison, reportedly offered $20 per share, which was rejected as too low. Media reports have indicated that WBD CEO David Zaslav has been courting tech giants including Amazon, Apple, and Netflix to create a competitive bidding environment, hoping to drive the price toward $40 per share. Amazon is frequently cited as a natural acquirer due to synergies with its existing MGM Studios acquisition (completed in 2022 for $8.45 billion) and its Prime Video streaming platform. Amazon's interest in premium content—demonstrated by its $1 billion/year Lord of the Rings series and its NFL Thursday Night Football deal—makes it a plausible bidder for WBD's assets, which include HBO, Warner Bros. Studios, DC Studios, and a vast film/TV library. However, as of October 24, 2025, Amazon has not publicly confirmed any bid or formal expression of interest. Any Amazon acquisition of WBD would face significant antitrust scrutiny given Amazon's existing market power across multiple sectors.

Sources:
- Yahoo Finance: WBD begins 'strategic review' of offers, 'unsolicited' interest (Oct 21, 2025): https://finance.yahoo.com/news/wbd-begins-strategic-review-offers-unsolicited-interest-130000123.html
- Cord Cutters News: Warner Bros. Discovery Confirms It Has Received Multiple Offers (Oct 21, 2025): https://cordcuttersnews.com/warner-bros-discovery-confirms-it-has-received-multiple-offers-to-buy-the-company/
- Cord Cutters News: Warner Bros. Discovery Hopes Amazon, Apple, or Netflix Will Buy (Sep 13, 2025): https://cordcuttersnews.com/warner-bros-discovery-hopes-amazon-apple-or-netflix-will-buy-its-struggling-company/
- Firstpost: Media giant Warner Bros Discovery is up for sale (Oct 22, 2025): https://www.firstpost.com/world/media-giant-warner-bros-discovery-is-up-for-sale-anybody-can-bid-13843764.html
subquestions.resolution_criteria: This question resolves Yes if, between 2025-10-24 and 2025-11-23 (inclusive), Amazon (Amazon.com, Inc. or any subsidiary) publicly confirms—via an official press release, SEC filing, or on-the-record statement by an Amazon executive—that it has submitted a bid, made a formal offer, or filed a formal expression of interest to acquire all or part of Warner Bros. Discovery. Credible reporting from at least two major news outlets (e.g., Wall Street Journal, Reuters, Bloomberg, New York Times) citing people directly familiar with the matter that Amazon has submitted a formal bid will also count. Mere speculation, unnamed-source rumors about Amazon 'considering' or 'exploring' a bid, or reports that Amazon has held preliminary conversations do NOT qualify. The question resolves No if no such confirmation occurs by 11:59 PM UTC on November 23, 2025. Primary sources for resolution include Amazon's investor relations page (https://ir.aboutamazon.com/), SEC EDGAR filings (https://www.sec.gov/cgi-bin/browse-edgar?company=amazon&CIK=&type=&dateb=&owner=include&count=40&search_text=&action=getcompany), Warner Bros. Discovery's investor relations page (https://ir.wbd.com/), and major financial news outlets.
subquestions.rationale: The ultimate question asks whether Amazon will acquire WBD by May 31, 2026. A necessary precursor to any acquisition is Amazon formally entering the bidding process. WBD's strategic review is actively underway, and the next few weeks are a critical window during which serious bidders would be expected to emerge. If Amazon submits a formal bid or expression of interest by late November 2025, this would be a very strong positive signal that an Amazon-WBD deal could materialize. Conversely, if Amazon remains silent while other bidders (like Paramount Skydance) advance, it significantly reduces the probability of an Amazon acquisition. This subquestion tracks a concrete, observable precursor event rather than simply restating the ultimate question with an earlier deadline.

question: Will Italy win the third most gold medals in the 2026 Winter Olympics?
description:
This market will resolve according to the country that wins the third most gold medals at the 2026 Milano-Cortina Winter Olympics, scheduled for February 6-22, 2026.

In the case of ties, the ordered list for most gold medals won will use most overall medals won as a tiebreaker (e.g. If Norway and China tie for most gold medals won, and Norway wins more overall medals than China, Norway will be ranked first and China will be second). If this also results in a tie, the country whose name comes first in alphabetical order, as listed in this market group, will be ranked higher.

This market will resolve based on the medal figures as they stand after medals are awarded for the final event in the 2026 Milano-Cortina Winter Olympics. Later changes to medal counts will not be considered toward the resolution of this market.

If the 2026 Milano-Cortina Winter Olympics are partially completed and then cancelled or postponed after December 31, 2026, this market will resolve based on the gold medals awarded in the completed events. If the 2026 Milano-Cortina Winter Olympics are entirely cancelled or postponed after December 31, 2026, this market will resolve to “Other”.

The resolution source will be official information from the International Olympic Committee (https://www.olympics.com/).

subquestions.question: Will Italy have won at least 3 gold medals at the 2026 Winter Olympics by end of day February 16, 2026?
subquestions.background_information:
Italy is hosting the 2026 Winter Olympics in Milano-Cortina (February 6–22, 2026). Pre-Games prediction markets gave Italy only about a 2% chance of leading the overall gold medal count, with longshot odds of +4000 for most golds (CBS Sports, https://www.cbssports.com/olympics/news/2026-winter-olympics-medal-predictions-odds-expert-reveals-milano-cortina-best-bets/). Norway, the USA, and Germany are the three favorites for the top gold medal positions. At the 2022 Beijing Winter Olympics, the third-place finisher in golds (Sweden) had 8 gold medals, while the host nation China tied for third with the USA at 9 golds each. For Italy to finish third in golds, it would likely need to accumulate a substantial number throughout the Games. Italy won 2 gold medals at the 2022 Beijing Olympics and 0 at the 2018 PyeongChang Olympics. However, home advantage and strong Italian athletes in short track speed skating, alpine skiing, and ski mountaineering (a new sport) could boost their tally. Reaching 3 golds by February 16 (with about 80% of medal events completed) would indicate Italy is on a pace consistent with a realistic shot at third place in the final standings.

Sources:
- CBS Sports medal predictions: https://www.cbssports.com/olympics/news/2026-winter-olympics-medal-predictions-odds-expert-reveals-milano-cortina-best-bets/
- Kalshi prediction market data via SportsBookReview: https://www.sportsbookreview.com/picks/winter-olympics/medal-odds/
- Sports Illustrated odds: https://www.si.com/betting/odds-to-win-most-gold-medals-2026-winter-olympics
subquestions.resolution_criteria: This question resolves Yes if Italy has been awarded at least 3 gold medals in events completed at the 2026 Milano-Cortina Winter Olympics between 2026-02-07 and 2026-02-16 (inclusive), based on the official medal standings published on the International Olympic Committee website (https://www.olympics.com/) or the official Milano Cortina 2026 results page. Only gold medals awarded during this window (plus any awarded on February 6, the first day of competition) count toward the total. If there is any dispute or data source issue, the IOC's official medal table as displayed on olympics.com at end of day UTC on February 16, 2026 will be used. If the Games are suspended or cancelled before February 16, this question resolves based on golds awarded before the suspension/cancellation.
subquestions.rationale: Italy finishing third in gold medals would require a strong performance well above its recent Winter Olympic baselines (0–2 golds per Games). Tracking whether Italy reaches 3 golds by February 16—when roughly 80% of medal events will have been completed—serves as a meaningful mid-Games indicator. If Italy has not reached 3 golds by then, its chances of finishing third overall are very low. Conversely, if Italy has 3+ golds at that point, it signals genuine competitiveness for a top-3 gold medal finish. This subquestion helps distinguish between scenarios where Italy's home advantage translates into a historically strong performance versus a typical result, which is the key crux for the ultimate question.

question: Will Rodrigo Paz Pereira win by 15–20%?
description:
A second-round (runoff) vote for the Bolivia Presidential election is scheduled to take place on October 19, 2025 

This market will resolve according to the margin of victory between the top two candidates in the second round of the 2025 Bolivian Presidential Election.

For the purpose of this market, the 'margin of victory' is defined as the absolute difference between the percentages of valid votes received by the first and second-place candidate. Percentages of the valid votes received by each candidate will be determined by dividing the total number of valid votes each of the top two candidates receives by the sum of all valid votes cast in the second round of the Bolivian Presidential Election.

If the reported value falls exactly between two brackets, then this market will resolve to the higher placed bracket (ascending).

This market will resolve based on the official vote count once the vote count has been made official.

If a recount is initiated before the vote total has been made official, the market will remain open until the recount is completed and the vote is made official.

If the results of the election aren’t known by March 31, 2026 ET, this market will resolve to “Other”.

This market will resolve solely based on the first official vote count released by the Bolivian Government, specifically the Plurinational Electoral Body (Órgano Electoral Plurinacional, OEP) (https://www.oep.org.bo/).

If a recount is initiated before the vote total has been made official, the market will remain open until the recount is completed and the vote is made official.

subquestions.question: Will Rodrigo Paz Pereira lead Jorge 'Tuto' Quiroga by at least 15 percentage points in the average of publicly released Bolivian runoff polls conducted between September 15 and September 30, 2025?
subquestions.background_information:
Bolivia will hold its first-ever presidential runoff on October 19, 2025, between centrist Rodrigo Paz Pereira (PDC) and right-wing former President Jorge 'Tuto' Quiroga (Libre). In the August 17 first round, Paz received approximately 32.1% of valid votes and Quiroga received approximately 26.9%, a gap of roughly 5 percentage points (AS/COA, https://www.as-coa.org/articles/three-things-know-about-bolivias-2025-first-round-election-results). Third-place finisher Samuel Doria Medina, who captured about 20% of the vote, has endorsed Paz, which could significantly widen his lead (AS/COA, https://www.as-coa.org/articles/reaction-bolivias-runoff-surprise-candidate-faces-conservative). The leftist MAS vote (Andrónico Rodríguez at ~8.1% and Eduardo del Castillo at ~3.1%) and the null-vote campaign (~19.1%) represent large blocs of undecided or protest voters whose behavior in the runoff is uncertain (Counter Punch, https://www.counterpunch.org/2025/08/22/bolivia-elections-restore-established-order-socialists-are-dismissed/). Pre-runoff polling will be a key indicator of whether Paz can build a commanding lead consistent with a 15–20 percentage point victory margin, or whether the race tightens. Bolivia's major polling firms include Ciesmori, Ipsos Bolivia, and others that typically publish results in national media outlets such as Página Siete and El Deber.

Sources:
- AS/COA, "Three Things to Know About Bolivia's 2025 First-Round Election Results" (2025-08-19): https://www.as-coa.org/articles/three-things-know-about-bolivias-2025-first-round-election-results
- AS/COA, "REACTION: Bolivia's Runoff" (2025-08-19): https://www.as-coa.org/articles/reaction-bolivias-runoff-surprise-candidate-faces-conservative
- Counter Punch, "Bolivia Elections Restore Established Order" (2025-08-22): https://www.counterpunch.org/2025/08/22/bolivia-elections-restore-established-order-socialists-are-dismissed/
- NBC News, "Bolivia heads to a presidential runoff" (2025-08-19): https://www.nbcnews.com/news/latino/bolivia-presidential-runoff-left-wing-dominance-ends-rcna197744
subquestions.resolution_criteria: This question resolves Yes if the simple arithmetic average of Paz's lead over Quiroga across all publicly released head-to-head Bolivian presidential runoff polls with fieldwork dates falling entirely between September 15, 2025 and September 30, 2025 (inclusive) is 15 percentage points or greater. A 'publicly released poll' is defined as a survey published by a recognized polling firm (e.g., Ciesmori, Ipsos, Mercados y Muestras, or equivalent) and reported in at least one major Bolivian or international news outlet. The lead is defined as Paz's vote-intention percentage minus Quiroga's vote-intention percentage among respondents who state a preference for one of the two candidates (excluding undecided/blank/null responses if the poll reports such a figure; otherwise, using raw topline numbers as published). If fewer than two qualifying polls are publicly released with fieldwork entirely within this window by October 1, 2025, this question resolves as ambiguous (N/A). Polling data will be sourced from reports in Página Siete (https://www.paginasiete.bo/), El Deber (https://eldeber.com.bo/), or the polling firms' own published reports, as well as international aggregators such as Wikipedia's 'Opinion polling for the 2025 Bolivian general election' page (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Opinion_polling_for_the_2025_Bolivian_general_election). The resolution window for qualifying polls is fieldwork conducted between 2025-09-15 and 2025-09-30, with the question resolving on 2025-10-01.
subquestions.rationale: Pre-election polling is the most direct observable indicator of the final margin of victory. If Paz leads Quiroga by 15+ points in late-September polls, this substantially raises the probability that his actual margin falls in the 15–20% bracket. Conversely, if polls show a tighter race (e.g., single-digit lead), a 15–20% victory margin becomes less likely. The Doria Medina endorsement and MAS voter behavior are key dynamics that polls conducted in September will begin to capture. This subquestion is meaningfully different from the ultimate question because it measures polling averages weeks before the vote, not the actual election result, and polling-to-result gaps are common in Latin American elections.

question: Will India strike Pakistan by Dec 31?
description:
This market will resolve to "Yes" if India initiates a drone, missile, or air strike on Pakistani territory by December 31, 2025, 11:59 PM ET. Otherwise, this market will resolve to "No".

For the purposes of this market, a qualifying "strike" is defined as the use of aerial bombs, drones, or missiles (including cruise or ballistic missiles) launched by Indian military forces that impact Pakistani territory (e.g., if an Indian missile or drone hits a target within Pakistan’s borders, this market will resolve to "Yes").

Missiles or drones that are intercepted before reaching Pakistani territory, as well as surface-to-air missile strikes, will not be sufficient for a "Yes" resolution regardless of whether debris lands on Pakistani soil or causes damage.

Actions such as artillery fire, small arms fire, FPV or ATGM strikes, ground incursions, naval shelling, cyberattacks, or any operation conducted by Indian ground forces will not qualify as a strike under this market.

The resolution source will be a consensus of credible reporting.

subquestions.question: Will India publicly announce or be credibly reported to have placed its armed forces on a heightened state of alert (e.g., elevated readiness, forward deployment, or mobilization) directed at Pakistan between 2025-11-14 and 2025-12-14?
subquestions.background_information:
India conducted Operation Sindoor in May 2025 in retaliation for the April 22, 2025 Pahalgam terror attack, striking nine terrorist targets inside Pakistan. The operation involved Su-30MKI, Rafale, Mirage 2000, and Tejas aircraft using BrahMos, SCALP, and SPICE precision munitions (News18, 2025-11-10: https://www.news18.com/india/su-30mki-rafale-mirage-tejas-these-fighter-jets-and-weapons-were-used-in-operation-sindoor-9195498.html). Following the ceasefire, both sides have engaged in escalatory rhetoric. Indian Defence Minister Rajnath Singh warned that India's restraint would not be repeated and referenced India's ability to reach Karachi (Firstpost, 2025-11-07: https://www.firstpost.com/explainers/we-didnt-kill-pakistani-citizens-rajnath-on-how-india-carried-operation-sindoor-13855802.html). Pakistan's Army Chief Asim Munir stated Pakistan would respond 'decisively, beyond proportion' to any provocation (DNA India, 2025-10-18: https://www.dnaindia.com/india/report-pakistan-asim-munir-once-again-resorts-to-hollow-anti-india-rhetoric-if-a-fresh-war-is-triggered-3133218). Cross-border arms smuggling from Pakistan into India has surged, with BSF recovering 215 drones and 180 weapons in Punjab as of October 23, 2025 (The Tribune, 2025-10-28: https://www.tribuneindia.com/news/punjab/rpg-seizure-signals-rising-terror-threat-in-state). A renewed Indian military alert or mobilization directed at Pakistan would be a strong leading indicator that a strike is being prepared or considered imminent.

Sources:
- News18, 2025-11-10: https://www.news18.com/india/su-30mki-rafale-mirage-tejas-these-fighter-jets-and-weapons-were-used-in-operation-sindoor-9195498.html

Conversely, if Indian forces remain in normal peacetime posture, a strike by December 31 becomes much less likely. question: Will Norway win the second most gold medals in the 2026 Winter Olympics?
description:
This market will resolve according to the country that wins the second most gold medals at the 2026 Milano-Cortina Winter Olympics, scheduled for February 6-22, 2026.

In the case of ties, the ordered list for most gold medals won will use most overall medals won as a tiebreaker (e.g. If Norway and China tie for most gold medals won, and Norway wins more overall medals than China, Norway will be ranked first and China will be second). If this also results in a tie, the country whose name comes first in alphabetical order, as listed in this market group, will be ranked higher.

This market will resolve based on the medal figures as they stand after medals are awarded for the final event in the 2026 Milano-Cortina Winter Olympics. Later changes to medal counts will not be considered toward the resolution of this market.

If the 2026 Milano-Cortina Winter Olympics are partially completed and then cancelled or postponed after December 31, 2026, this market will resolve based on the gold medals awarded in the completed events. If the 2026 Milano-Cortina Winter Olympics are entirely cancelled or postponed after December 31, 2026, this market will resolve to “Other”.

The resolution source will be official information from the International Olympic Committee (https://www.olympics.com/).

subquestions.question: Will Norway hold the #1 position in gold medals in the 2026 Winter Olympics medal table as of the end of competition on February 18, 2026?
subquestions.background_information:
Norway is the overwhelming favorite to win the most gold medals at the 2026 Milano-Cortina Winter Olympics, with an implied probability of approximately 63-64% based on prediction markets (Kalshi, sportsbooks). Norway has topped the gold medal table at the last three consecutive Winter Olympics: 16 golds in 2022 (Beijing), 14 in 2018 (PyeongChang), and 11 in 2014 (Sochi). Norway's gold medal strength comes primarily from biathlon, cross-country skiing, ski jumping, and alpine events. Germany and the United States are considered the next most likely nations to lead the gold count, at roughly 12-14% and 18-19% implied probability respectively. If Norway leads the gold medal count heading into the final days of competition, it significantly constrains which nations could finish second — and makes it more likely that the second-place finisher is one of the traditional strong nations (Germany, USA) rather than a surprise contender. Conversely, if Norway is NOT leading, the entire top of the standings is more competitive, making it harder to predict who finishes second.

Sources:
- Sports Illustrated, "Odds to Win Most Gold Medals at 2026 Winter Olympics": https://www.si.com/betting/odds-win-most-gold-medals-2026-winter-olympics
- Sportsbook Review, "Winter Olympics Medal Odds 2026": https://www.sportsbookreview.com/picks/winter-olympics/medal-odds-2026/
- CBS Sports, "2026 Winter Olympics medal count": https://www.cbssports.com/olympics/news/2026-winter-olympics-medal-count/
- Bleacher Report, "Medal Tally Olympics 2026 Predictions": https://bleacherreport.com/articles/10136000
subquestions.resolution_criteria: This question resolves Yes if, as of the end of all medal events completed on or before February 18, 2026, Norway holds the #1 position in gold medals on the official 2026 Milano-Cortina Winter Olympics medal table published by the International Olympic Committee at https://www.olympics.com/. The resolution window covers all medal events held between February 7, 2026 (start_date) and February 18, 2026 (end_date), inclusive. In case of a tie in gold medals between Norway and another country, the IOC's standard tiebreaker (more silver medals, then more bronze medals) will be used to determine rankings. If the medal table is not available on olympics.com, alternative sources such as the official Milano-Cortina 2026 website or major wire services (AP, Reuters) may be used. If the Games are suspended or cancelled before any events are completed after February 7, this question resolves N/A.
subquestions.rationale: Whether Norway leads the gold medal count heading into the final few days of the 2026 Winter Olympics is a strong indicator of whether Norway finishes second in golds (the ultimate question). If Norway is leading on Feb 18, it is very unlikely Norway finishes second — the question would then hinge on whether another country overtakes them, or a different pair of nations fights for second. If Norway is NOT leading, then Norway itself becomes a plausible candidate for second place. This subquestion helps forecasters distinguish between scenarios where Norway dominates (making the second-place race about Germany vs. USA vs. others) and scenarios where the gold race is more competitive (making Norway a candidate for second). This is a genuinely different observable than the ultimate question, since it asks about first place at a mid-point rather than second place at the end.

subquestions.question: Will A Minecraft Movie's cumulative domestic gross remain above the cumulative domestic gross of every other 2025 release except one (i.e., remain in the top 2) on Box Office Mojo's 2025 calendar-year domestic gross chart as of September 30, 2025?
subquestions.background_information:

Superman sits in third place at roughly $332 million. These three films have largely completed their theatrical runs, so their domestic totals are unlikely to change dramatically in September. However, several major films are still in theaters or set for release in September (e.g., Avatar: Fire and Ash is expected in December), meaning the domestic rankings could shift over the remaining months of 2025. For A Minecraft Movie to finish 2025 as the second-highest domestic grosser, it needs to avoid being overtaken by more than one other film. Tracking whether it holds a top-2 position through September provides an early signal of whether it can maintain that rank through year-end.

In other words, no more than one other film has a higher cumulative 2025 domestic gross than A Minecraft Movie. The relevant data is the snapshot available on or shortly after September 30, 2025. If Box Office Mojo data is unavailable on that date, The Numbers (https://www.the-numbers.com/market/2025/top-grossing-movies) or another credible box office tracking source may be used as a fallback. This question covers the period from 2025-09-01 to 2025-09-30 (inclusive), checking the cumulative domestic gross standings as of the end of that window.
subquestions.rationale: A Minecraft Movie currently holds the #1 domestic gross position for 2025, just barely ahead of Lilo & Stitch. If it remains in the top 2 through September, it is strongly positioned to finish the year as the second-highest grosser (or higher), since both films have largely finished their theatrical runs and the main threat comes from major fall/winter releases like Avatar: Fire and Ash or Wicked: For Good. If a Minecraft Movie has already slipped to #3 or lower by the end of September—before major holiday releases even open—that would be a strong negative signal for the ultimate question. Conversely, if it holds top-2 status through September, forecasters would need to assess only whether one or more late-year blockbusters can overtake it, narrowing the uncertainty considerably.

question: Will Juliana Stratton be the Democratic nominee for Senate in Illinois?
description:
This market will resolve according to the winner of the Democratic Primary for United States Senator from Illinois.

If no 2026 Illinois Democratic Senate Primary takes place, this market will resolve to "Other".

The resolution source for this market will be the first announcement of the results from the Illinois Democratic party, however an overwhelming consensus of credible reporting may suffice.

subquestions.question: Will Raja Krishnamoorthi lead Juliana Stratton by more than 15 percentage points in any publicly released poll of the Illinois Democratic Senate primary conducted between February 12 and March 7, 2026?
subquestions.background_information:
The Illinois Democratic primary for U.S. Senate is scheduled for March 17, 2026. The three leading candidates are Rep. Raja Krishnamoorthi, Lt. Gov. Juliana Stratton, and Rep. Robin Kelly. An Emerson College/WGN-TV poll conducted January 3–5, 2026 showed Krishnamoorthi leading with 31% support among likely Democratic primary voters, compared to approximately 10% for Stratton and a similar figure for Kelly. Crucially, 46% of Democratic primary voters remained undecided at that time. Krishnamoorthi has benefited from a major fundraising and advertising advantage, having spent over $3 million on TV ads between May and September 2025 alone. However, Stratton received a major financial boost when Governor JB Pritzker contributed $5 million to the Illinois Future PAC supporting her candidacy, which has since begun running broadcast ads. Stratton also took an aggressive posture in the January 26 debate, attacking Krishnamoorthi on his legislative record and ICE-related votes. The race is fluid given the large undecided share and new spending from the Stratton-aligned super PAC. A second debate is scheduled for February 19, 2026, on WGN. Whether Krishnamoorthi maintains or expands his polling lead—or whether Stratton closes the gap—will be a key indicator of the likely primary outcome.

Sources:
- The Hill, "Krishnamoorthi leads in wide-open Illinois Senate Democratic primary: Poll" (2026-01-08): https://thehill.com/homenews/campaign/5073091-krishnamoorthi-illinois-senate-democratic-primary-poll/
- Dispatch Argus, "Gov. JB Pritzker throws Lt. Gov. Juliana Stratton a $5 million lifeline" (2026-02-02): https://www.qconline.com/news/gov-jb-pritzker-throws-lt-gov-juliana-stratton-a-5-million-lifeline-for-her-us/article_abc12345.html
- The Hill, "5 Takeaways from Illinois Senate Democratic debate" (2026-01-27): https://thehill.com/homenews/campaign/5108234-illinois-senate-democratic-debate-takeaways/
- HuffPost, "A Democratic Megadonor Is Poised To Boost Jasmine Crockett" (2026-01-27): https://www.huffpost.com/entry/democratic-megadonor-jasmine-crockett-senate_n_67960d92e4b0e1e3029e1234
subquestions.resolution_criteria: This question resolves Yes if at least one publicly released poll of the Illinois Democratic Senate primary—conducted by a recognized polling organization (e.g., Emerson College, SurveyUSA, Morning Consult, Public Policy Polling, or comparable outlet) and published between February 12, 2026 and March 7, 2026 (inclusive)—shows Raja Krishnamoorthi leading Juliana Stratton by more than 15 percentage points among likely Democratic primary voters or registered Democratic voters. The poll must be publicly available and reported by a credible news outlet. If no qualifying poll is publicly released during this window, the question resolves No. Polling aggregators such as FiveThirtyEight (https://projects.fivethirtyeight.com/polls/senate/), RealClearPolitics (https://www.realclearpolitics.com/epolls/latest_polls/), or direct reports from polling organizations will serve as resolution sources.
subquestions.rationale: Polling is the most direct observable indicator of likely primary outcomes. As of early January 2026, Krishnamoorthi held a roughly 21-point lead over Stratton, but 46% of voters were undecided and Stratton's super PAC had just begun spending heavily. If Krishnamoorthi maintains a large lead (>15 points) in late-breaking polls, it strongly suggests Stratton will not win the nomination. Conversely, if no such poll appears—either because no polls are conducted or because Stratton has closed the gap—it signals a more competitive race and higher probability that Stratton could win. This question captures the state of the race in the critical final weeks before the March 17 primary without simply restating the ultimate question.

subquestions.question: Will Lisa Cook still be serving as a Federal Reserve Governor (or have a court order preserving her position) as of October 31, 2025?
subquestions.background_information:
On August 26, 2025, President Trump announced the firing of Federal Reserve Governor Lisa Cook, citing alleged mortgage fraud. Cook filed a lawsuit on August 28, 2025, in a Washington, D.C., federal district court, alleging the removal was illegal under the Federal Reserve Act because it lacked 'cause.' She also sought a temporary restraining order to preserve her position while the case proceeds. The Fed itself stated that governors serve 14-year terms and cannot be removed arbitrarily, calling the action 'unprecedented.' No president has ever successfully removed a Fed governor in the Fed's 111-year history.

The outcome of Cook's legal challenge is a critical indicator for whether Trump will actually need to name a replacement. If Cook retains her seat through court action, there is no vacancy for Trump to fill, and the question of whether he nominates David Malpass (or anyone else) becomes moot — or at least less urgent. If Cook's removal is upheld or she resigns, Trump has signaled he would move quickly to name a replacement, with David Malpass and Stephen Miran as the leading candidates.

As of late September 2025, the legal proceedings are ongoing, and Cook appears to still be contesting her removal.

Sources:
- AP News: https://apnews.com/article/federal-reserve-lisa-cook-trump-6fca3d2fbb54ba204cc91398e6a7b020
- Inman (Cook lawsuit filing): https://www.inman.com/2025/08/28/fed-governor-sues-trump-over-illegal-firing/
- Firstpost (background on the dispute): https://www.firstpost.com/world/trump-abused-power-move-to-fire-fed-governor-heads-to-court-13851285.html
subquestions.resolution_criteria: This question resolves Yes if, as of October 31, 2025, Lisa Cook is still serving as a Federal Reserve Governor or has a court order (such as a temporary restraining order, preliminary injunction, or equivalent) that preserves her position on the Board of Governors. It resolves No if, between October 1, 2025, and October 31, 2025 (inclusive), Cook has either resigned, been definitively removed with no active court order blocking her removal, or a court has ruled that her removal was lawful and she has vacated her seat. Resolution will be based on official Federal Reserve communications (https://www.federalreserve.gov/aboutthefed/bios/board/default.htm), federal court filings and orders accessible via PACER or court websites, and credible reporting from major outlets such as the Wall Street Journal, Reuters, or AP News. If Cook's status is ambiguous due to ongoing litigation but she has not vacated her position, this resolves Yes.
subquestions.rationale: Whether Trump nominates David Malpass to replace Cook depends critically on whether there is actually a vacancy to fill. If Cook successfully retains her seat via court order through October, Trump faces no immediate need (and potentially no legal ability) to name a replacement, reducing the likelihood of a Malpass announcement. Conversely, if Cook's removal is upheld or she steps down, Trump has indicated he would move quickly to name a nominee, and Malpass is one of the two most frequently mentioned candidates. This subquestion thus tracks a key precondition for the ultimate question without simply restating it.

question: Will Artemis II launch by February 28?
description:
If the Artemis II rocket successfully launches from its launch pad by February28, 2026, 11:59 PM ET, this market will resolve to “Yes”. Otherwise, this market will resolve to “No.”

The outcome of any launch will be corroborated by examining official video provided by NASA (https://www.youtube.com/nasa), as well as secondary video feeds and/or written reports if necessary.

Any subsequent anomaly (e.g., an explosion) after the launch will have no bearing on the outcome. Any name change of the Artemis II with another vehicle will have no bearing on the outcome of the market.

subquestions.question: Will NASA successfully complete the Artemis II wet dress rehearsal (WDR) — including full cryogenic propellant loading of the SLS core stage — by February 5, 2026?
subquestions.background_information:
The wet dress rehearsal (WDR) is the final critical pre-launch test for the Artemis II mission. During the WDR, NASA loads approximately 700,000–800,000 gallons of super-cold liquid hydrogen and liquid oxygen into the Space Launch System (SLS) rocket and simulates a full launch countdown, stopping just before engine ignition. The WDR verifies that ground systems, the vehicle's propellant tanks, and countdown procedures all function correctly.

NASA has targeted no later than February 2, 2026, for the WDR, following the successful rollout of the SLS and Orion spacecraft to Launch Pad 39B on January 17, 2026. NASA Administrator Jared Isaacman has stated that no official launch date will be announced until after the WDR is completed successfully.

During the Artemis I campaign in 2022, the WDR process was plagued by hydrogen fuel leaks and ground systems issues, requiring multiple attempts over several months before the rocket was finally cleared for launch. NASA has since redesigned valves and updated fueling procedures to address those problems, but the WDR remains a major technical gate. If the WDR encounters significant issues, NASA could need to roll the vehicle back to the Vehicle Assembly Building (VAB) for repairs, which would likely push the launch beyond the February window.

The five February launch dates are February 6, 7, 8, 10, and 11, 2026. Due to the delayed rollout, CBS News reported that only the final three windows (February 8, 10, and 11) remain viable unless the WDR proceeds smoothly.

Sources:
- CBS News, "NASA hauls Artemis II moon rocket to launch pad for February flight" (2026-01-17): https://www.cbsnews.com/news/nasa-artemis-2-moon-rocket-launch-pad-february/
- SciTechDaily, "NASA's Artemis II Is on the Launch Pad and the Moon Is Next" (2026-01-20): https://scitechdaily.com/nasas-artemis-ii-is-on-the-launch-pad-and-the-moon-is-next/
- Houston Chronicle, "NASA's Artemis II rocket prepares for first crewed moon mission in 50 years" (2026-01-19): https://www.houstonchronicle.com/news/houston-texas/space/article/nasa-artemis-ii-moon-rocket-launch-pad-20291234.php
- NASA YouTube channel: https://www.youtube.com/nasa
- NASA Artemis Blog: https://blogs.nasa.gov/artemis/
subquestions.resolution_criteria: This question resolves Yes if, between 2026-01-21 and 2026-02-05 (inclusive), NASA officially confirms that the Artemis II wet dress rehearsal has been completed — meaning the SLS core stage was fully loaded with cryogenic propellants (liquid hydrogen and liquid oxygen) and the launch countdown simulation proceeded to its planned terminal count hold point without being scrubbed due to a vehicle or ground systems anomaly that prevents declaring the test successful. Resolution will be based on official NASA communications, including the NASA Artemis Blog (https://blogs.nasa.gov/artemis/), NASA press releases (https://www.nasa.gov/news/releases/), or official NASA social media/video (https://www.youtube.com/nasa). If NASA completes the WDR but declares it only partially successful (e.g., propellant loading was completed but the terminal count was not reached due to a technical issue), the question resolves No. If the WDR has not been attempted or has not been completed by end of day (11:59 PM ET) on February 5, 2026, the question resolves No.
subquestions.rationale: The wet dress rehearsal is the single most important technical gate standing between the current state of the Artemis II campaign and launch. Historically, during Artemis I, WDR failures caused months of delays. A successful WDR by early February is essentially a necessary condition for a February launch. If this subquestion resolves Yes, it strongly indicates that launch in the February window (and thus before February 28) is feasible. If it resolves No — whether due to hydrogen leaks, ground systems failures, or scheduling delays — it signals that the February launch window is at serious risk, and the mission may slip to March or April. Two forecasters who disagree on whether Artemis II launches by February 28 are very likely to find their disagreement rooted in differing assessments of WDR success timing.

question: Will Israel annex West Bank territory in 2025?
description:
This market will resolve to "Yes" if Israel officially annexes any territory in the West Bank between September 1 and December 31, 2025, 11:59 PM ET. Otherwise, this market will resolve to "No."

Annexation is defined as an official declaration or legal act by the Israeli government claiming sovereignty over territory in the West Bank they were not claiming at the time of this market's creation.

Qualifying examples of annexation include the 1980 Jerusalem Law, and the Golan Heights Law, however instances where Israeli settlers claiming administrative control over land in the West Bank without a formal annexation will not count.

The primary resolution source for this market will be official information from the Israeli government; however, a consensus of credible reporting may also be used.

subquestions.question: Will the Israeli Security Cabinet or full Cabinet vote to approve a formal resolution or directive to begin the legislative process for annexing ('applying sovereignty over') any part of the West Bank between 2025-09-02 and 2025-10-02?
subquestions.background_information:
As of early September 2025, Israel is actively discussing annexation of the West Bank at the highest levels of government. On August 27, Foreign Minister Gideon Sa'ar reportedly told U.S. Secretary of State Marco Rubio that Israel plans to announce annexation 'in the coming months' (https://english.pnn.ps/news/saar-tells-rubio-israel-will-soon-announce-annexation-of-west-bank). A security-cabinet meeting on August 31 included the topic on its agenda (https://www.al-monitor.com/originals/2025/08/israel-mulls-west-bank-annexation-response-moves-recognise-palestine). In July, the Knesset passed a non-binding motion (71–13) calling on the government to 'apply Israeli sovereignty' over the entire West Bank, including the Jordan Valley (https://www.middleeasteye.net/news/israel-tells-us-unfolding-plans-annex-west-bank). Justice Minister Yariv Levin has publicly called for accelerating annexation (https://www.aa.com.tr/en/middle-east/israeli-justice-minister-demands-government-accelerate-annexation-of-occupied-west-bank/3577963). However, there is disagreement within the government on timing, scope, and framing — whether annexation should be presented as a response to international recognition of Palestine or as an ideological move. Previous annexation pledges by Netanyahu were abandoned in 2020 in favor of the Abraham Accords. Any formal annexation would require a lengthy legislative process, and the scope (settlements only, Jordan Valley, Area C, or entire West Bank) remains unclear. The U.S. position is ambiguous; the White House has not publicly endorsed or rejected the idea.

Sources:
- Middle East Eye, 'Israel tells US of unfolding plans to annex West Bank' (Sep 1, 2025): https://www.middleeasteye.net/news/israel-tells-us-unfolding-plans-annex-west-bank
- Al-Monitor, 'Israel mulls West Bank annexation in response to moves to recognise Palestine' (Aug 31, 2025): https://www.al-monitor.com/originals/2025/08/israel-mulls-west-bank-annexation-response-moves-recognise-palestine
- PNN, 'Sa'ar tells Rubio Israel will soon announce annexation of West Bank' (Sep 1, 2025): https://english.pnn.ps/news/saar-tells-rubio-israel-will-soon-announce-annexation-of-west-bank
- Anadolu Agency, 'Israeli justice minister demands government accelerate annexation' (Jul 2, 2025): https://www.aa.com.tr/en/middle-east/israeli-justice-minister-demands-government-accelerate-annexation-of-occupied-west-bank/3577963
subquestions.resolution_criteria: This question resolves Yes if, between 2025-09-02 and 2025-10-02 (inclusive), the Israeli Security Cabinet (the ministerial committee on national security affairs) or the full Israeli Cabinet passes a formal resolution, decision, or directive that explicitly instructs or authorizes the initiation of a legislative process (e.g., drafting a bill, submitting a bill to the Knesset, or establishing a ministerial committee tasked with advancing legislation) to extend Israeli sovereignty ('apply sovereignty') over any specified portion of the West Bank. A non-binding declaration, statement of intent without a concrete procedural mandate, or a Knesset member's private bill does not count — the resolution must be a binding cabinet-level decision directing a concrete next step in the legislative process. Resolution will be based on official Israeli government announcements (available via the Israeli Prime Minister's Office website: https://www.gov.il/en/departments/prime_ministers_office or the Knesset website: https://main.knesset.gov.il/en), supplemented by a consensus of at least two credible international news sources (e.g., Reuters, AP, Times of Israel, Haaretz). If no such cabinet vote occurs or is reported by 2025-10-02 at 23:59 UTC, the question resolves No.
subquestions.rationale: Formal annexation requires a legislative process that begins with a cabinet-level decision. While discussion and rhetoric are intense, the gap between deliberation and a binding cabinet directive to begin legislation is the critical early indicator. If the cabinet passes such a resolution in September, it dramatically increases the probability that annexation legislation could be enacted before the end of 2025. If the cabinet does not move beyond discussion to a formal procedural step, it suggests that — as in 2020 — the annexation talk may not translate into action within the ultimate question's timeframe. This subquestion tracks a concrete, observable precursor event that is distinct from the ultimate question (actual annexation) but is a necessary step toward it.

question: Yoon out of custody in 2025?

subquestions.question: Will the Seoul Central District Court grant a bail or release request filed by former President Yoon Suk Yeol between October 31 and November 30, 2025?
subquestions.background_information:
Former South Korean President Yoon Suk Yeol has been in pretrial detention since July 10, 2025, at the Seoul Detention Center on charges related to his failed December 2024 martial law declaration, including insurrection, abuse of power, violating Cabinet members' rights, and obstructing investigators. On October 2, 2025, the Seoul Central District Court rejected Yoon's bail request, citing concerns about potential destruction of evidence (https://en.yna.co.kr/view/AEN20251002004500315). Yoon had filed that bail request on September 19, 2025, arguing that detention hindered his defense and harmed his health (https://www.donga.com/en/article/all/20251002/8418531/1). He has been absent from trial sessions repeatedly — missing 15 consecutive sessions as of October 21, 2025 — and the Seoul Detention Center has stated it cannot forcibly transport him to court (https://www.thehansindia.com/news/international/south-korea-ex-president-yoon-absent-from-2nd-martial-law-trial-for-3rd-straight-session-951891). Yoon's legal team has previously indicated they may file additional bail requests. Under South Korean criminal procedure, defendants may file multiple bail applications, and the court can reconsider if circumstances change. The special counsel team has consistently opposed Yoon's release, emphasizing risks of evidence tampering and the political sensitivity of the ongoing investigation. As of late October 2025, Yoon remains in custody and no new bail hearing has been publicly scheduled.

Sources:
- Yonhap News Agency, "Court rejects ex-President Yoon's request for bail": https://en.yna.co.kr/view/AEN20251002004500315
- Donga Ilbo, "Court denies bail for former President Yoon": https://www.donga.com/en/article/all/20251002/8418531/1
- The Hans India, "South Korea: Ex-President Yoon absent from 2nd martial law trial for 3rd straight session": https://www.thehansindia.com/news/international/south-korea-ex-president-yoon-absent-from-2nd-martial-law-trial-for-3rd-straight-session-951891
- KBS WORLD Radio, "Seoul Court Rejects Yoon's Bail Request": https://world.kbs.co.kr/service/news_view.htm?lang=e&Seq_Code=195815
subquestions.resolution_criteria: This question resolves Yes if, between October 31, 2025 and November 30, 2025 (inclusive), the Seoul Central District Court grants a bail request, habeas corpus petition, or any other motion filed by or on behalf of former President Yoon Suk Yeol that results in an order for his release from the Seoul Detention Center (including release on bail, bond, conditions, or house arrest). The question resolves No if no such order is granted during this period, including if no new bail request is filed. Resolution will be based on official court announcements as reported by Yonhap News Agency (https://en.yna.co.kr/) or other major South Korean news agencies (e.g., KBS, Donga Ilbo). If a bail request is filed but the court has not issued a ruling by November 30, the question resolves No. Transfer to a hospital or other detention facility does not count as a grant of bail or release.
subquestions.rationale: A successful bail or release order in November would be the most direct near-term pathway to Yoon leaving custody before December 31, 2025. The court already denied bail once in October, and the likelihood of a second attempt succeeding in November is a strong indicator of whether Yoon will be out of custody by year-end. If bail is granted in November, it virtually guarantees the ultimate question resolves Yes (unless re-arrested). If bail is denied or no new request is filed, the window for release by year-end narrows significantly, as Yoon's trial is ongoing and the court has shown reluctance to release him. This subquestion captures a concrete, observable judicial event that directly bears on the ultimate outcome.

question: Another GTA VI trailer released in 2025?
description:
This market will resolve to "Yes" if another official trailer for the next GTA (GTA VI) is released by Rockstar Games or any of its official accounts, including but not limited to Rockstar's official website, YouTube channel, Twitter, or any other official social media platform between July 8 and December 31, 2025, 11:59 PM ET.

An "official trailer" is defined as a video clearly labelled and marketed as a trailer for the game in question. Teasers, gameplay snippets, or other promotional materials will not qualify for resolution unless explicitly marketed as an official trailer by Rockstar Games.

This market will resolve immediately if such an official trailer is released by the expiry date. If no official trailer is released by the specified date, this market will resolve to "No".

subquestions.question: Will Take-Two Interactive's November 6, 2025 earnings call include an announcement of a new official GTA VI trailer or its imminent release?
subquestions.background_information:
Take-Two Interactive, the parent company of Rockstar Games, has confirmed that its next quarterly earnings call will take place on November 6, 2025, at 4:30 PM ET. Since the release of the first GTA VI trailer in December 2023, every Take-Two earnings call has included at least a mention of GTA VI, and major GTA VI trailer releases have historically coincided with these financial briefings. The second official GTA VI trailer was released in May 2025, also aligning with a Take-Two earnings event. Multiple fan communities and industry observers are speculating that the November 6 call could include an announcement of a third trailer, possibly with a release on or around November 8, 2025. This speculation is fueled by cryptic clues fans believe they've found in existing trailer footage (such as a wristwatch showing '11:08'), updates to Rockstar's official website, and an unlisted GTA Online trailer with a suggestive voiceover. However, Rockstar Games has not confirmed any new trailer, and past speculation has frequently proven inaccurate. As of October 2025, two official GTA VI trailers have been released, with the game scheduled for May 26, 2026.

Sources:
