The announcement must come from an official source: the Take-Two earnings call transcript/webcast (available at https://ir.take2games.com/), Rockstar Games' official website (https://www.rockstargames.com/), or Rockstar's verified social media accounts (YouTube, X/Twitter). General mentions of GTA VI progress, marketing timelines, or vague statements about upcoming content do not count unless they specifically reference a new trailer. This question covers events occurring between 2025-10-31 and 2025-11-13. If the earnings call is postponed beyond November 13, 2025, this question resolves No.
subquestions.rationale: The Take-Two earnings call on November 6 is widely considered the most likely venue for the next major GTA VI announcement. Previous trailer releases have aligned with these calls. If Take-Two announces or previews a third trailer during or immediately after this call, it is an extremely strong indicator that a new GTA VI trailer will be released in 2025, directly resolving the ultimate question. Conversely, if the call passes without any trailer announcement, it significantly reduces (though does not eliminate) the probability of a third trailer in 2025, as there would be fewer natural announcement windows remaining. This subquestion captures a concrete, near-term observable event that is highly informative for the ultimate question without simply being a time-shifted version of it.

question: Will 'Zootopia 2' have the second best domestic opening weekend in 2025?
description:
This is a market on how whether 'Zootopia 2' (2025) will have the second-highest domestic gross on its opening weekend compared to all other movies released in 2025. The “Weekend Box Office Performance” table on https://www.the-numbers.com/movie/Zootopia-2-(2025)#tab=box-office will be used to resolve this market once the values for the 3-day opening weekend (November 28 - 30) are final (i.e. not studio estimates).

This market will resolve to "Yes" if 'Zootopia 2' (2025) grosses the second-highest on its 3-day domestic opening weekend compared to any other movie in 2025. Otherwise, this market will resolve to "No".

Please note, this market will resolve according to the The Numbers figures provided under Weekend Box Office Performance for the 3-day weekend, regardless of whether domestic refers to only the USA, or to USA and Canada, etc.

Resolution will be based specifically on the figures provided for this movie's 3-day opening weekend (Friday, Saturday, Sunday), regardless of whether the movie has a 4 or 5-day opening weekend.

If two other movies' opening weekend box office performances surpass that of 'Zootopia 2' (2025) after the respective numbers are finalized, this market may immediately resolve to "No".

If this movie's opening weekend box office performance ties with any other's, the movie whose title comes first in alphabetical order will rank higher.

If there is no final data available by January 31, 2026, 11:59 PM ET, another credible resolution source will be chosen.

subquestions.question: Will 'Wicked: For Good' gross $130 million or more in its 3-day domestic opening weekend (November 21-23, 2025)?
subquestions.background_information:
Zootopia 2 opens on Thanksgiving weekend (November 26, 2025) and is projected to earn between $95 million and $130 million in its 3-day domestic opening weekend, depending on the source. For Zootopia 2 to have the second-best domestic opening weekend of 2025, it needs exactly one film to open higher. As of late October 2025, the biggest domestic opening weekends of 2025 include A Minecraft Movie (~$162 million), Lilo & Stitch (~$141 million), and Superman (~$125 million). Wicked: For Good opens one week before Zootopia 2 on November 21, 2025, and is projected for a domestic opening weekend between $112 million and $155 million, depending on the forecaster. If Wicked: For Good opens above $130 million, it would likely rank among the top 2-3 openings of the year, potentially pushing Zootopia 2 down to third or lower. Conversely, if Wicked: For Good opens below $130 million, it becomes more plausible that Zootopia 2 could land in second place if it hits the higher end of its projections. The first Wicked film opened to $112.5 million domestically in November 2024. Boxofficepro.com projects Wicked: For Good at $130-$155 million, while other trackers have it at $112-$115 million (Comicbook, October 30, 2025).

Sources:
- Comicbook: Wicked: For Good Projected For One of Year's Biggest Box Office Openings (Oct 30, 2025): https://comicbook.com/movies/news/wicked-for-good-projected-for-one-of-years-biggest-box-office-openings/
- Boxofficepro: Long Range Forecast for Zootopia 2 (Oct 24, 2025): https://www.boxofficepro.com/long-range-tracking-zootopia-2/
- The Numbers - 2025 domestic box office: https://www.the-numbers.com/market/2025/top-grossing-movies
- Movieweb: Zootopia 2 projections (Oct 19, 2025): https://movieweb.com/zootopia-2-projected-for-one-of-the-biggest-opening-weekends-of-2025/
subquestions.resolution_criteria: This question resolves Yes if 'Wicked: For Good' (2025) grosses $130 million or more in its 3-day domestic opening weekend (Friday November 21 through Sunday November 23, 2025), based on final (not estimated) figures from The Numbers (https://www.the-numbers.com/movie/Wicked-For-Good#tab=box-office) under the 'Weekend Box Office Performance' table for its opening weekend. The resolution window is between 2025-10-31 and 2025-11-29. If final numbers are not yet available on The Numbers by November 29, 2025, studio-reported actuals or Box Office Mojo (https://www.boxofficemojo.com/) may be used as a fallback. If the film's release is delayed beyond November 23, 2025, this question resolves No.
subquestions.rationale: The number of films that open bigger than Zootopia 2 determines whether it can claim the second-best opening weekend of 2025. Currently, A Minecraft Movie (~$162M) and Lilo & Stitch (~$141M) already sit above most Zootopia 2 projections. If Wicked: For Good also opens very large (≥$130M), that would make it extremely difficult for Zootopia 2 to rank second — it would need to beat at least two of those three films. Knowing Wicked: For Good's actual opening weekend gross, which occurs one week before Zootopia 2 opens, is a critical leading indicator for whether Zootopia 2 can realistically achieve the second-best opening of the year.

question: X relaunches Vine in 2025?
description:
This market will resolve to "Yes" if X relaunches Vine by December 31, 2025, 11:59 PM ET. Otherwise, this market will resolve to "No".

"Relaunching Vine" is defined as launching a platform and/or feature that performs similar functions to Vine, and is branded as a "relaunch of Vine" by Elon Musk or X itself. Note - the relaunch must be live and broadly accessible to the public before the resolution date for this market to resolve to "Yes".

The primary resolution source will be the Vine platform, as well as official information from Elon Musk and X, however a consensus of credible reporting will also be used.

subquestions.question: Will X publicly launch or make broadly accessible a restored Vine video archive by October 31, 2025?
subquestions.background_information:
In late July and early August 2025, Elon Musk announced on X that the platform would bring back Vine 'in AI form.' Subsequent reporting indicated that X had located the full library of the original Vine video archive and was working on restoring user access. According to Winbuzzer, the restored Vine archive could go live as early as October 2025, suggesting an imminent timeline. The AI-powered video creation tool associated with the relaunch is called 'Grok Imagine,' which would let users generate six-second videos from text prompts. However, as of late September 2025, no public-facing Vine archive or Vine-branded product has been launched on X. The ultimate question asks whether X relaunches Vine by December 31, 2025, where 'relaunching' requires a live, publicly accessible platform or feature branded as a Vine relaunch by Musk or X. Whether the archive restoration—reportedly targeted for October—actually ships on time is a strong early indicator of whether the full relaunch will happen by year-end.

Sources:
- Winbuzzer, "X to Resurrect Vine Archive in AI-Powered Push for Video Dominance" (2025-08-04): https://winbuzzer.com
- New York Post, "Elon Musk says X will bring back Vine with an AI twist" (2025-08-04): https://nypost.com
- Investopedia, "Elon Musk Says He's Bringing Back Vine" (2025-07-24): https://www.investopedia.com
- The A.V. Club, "Elon Musk circles back to his dream of relaunching Vine" (2025-07-24): https://www.avclub.com
subquestions.resolution_criteria: This question resolves Yes if, between 2025-10-01 and 2025-10-31 (inclusive), X (formerly Twitter) makes a restored Vine video archive publicly accessible to general users on the X platform or a dedicated Vine website/app. 'Publicly accessible' means any user with a standard X account (free or paid) can browse or view archived Vine videos through an official X or Vine-branded interface—a closed beta, internal test, or employees-only rollout does not count. Resolution will be based on official announcements from X or Elon Musk on X (https://x.com/elonmusk), the existence of a publicly accessible Vine archive URL, and corroborating coverage from at least two credible news outlets (e.g., The Verge at https://www.theverge.com, TechCrunch at https://techcrunch.com, or similar). If the archive launch is announced but delayed beyond October 31, 2025, or if only a teaser/preview page is made available without actual video content being browsable, the question resolves No.
subquestions.rationale: Reporting from August 2025 indicated the restored Vine archive could go live as early as October 2025. Whether X actually ships the archive on this reported timeline is a strong leading indicator for the ultimate question about a full Vine relaunch by year-end. If the archive—a foundational component of the relaunch—does not materialize in October, it significantly reduces the likelihood that a full, publicly branded Vine relaunch (including the AI creation tools) will be live by December 31, 2025. Conversely, if the archive does launch in October, it demonstrates concrete execution momentum and makes a full relaunch by year-end substantially more likely.

question: Will Wesley Hunt come in 3rd in the 2026 Texas Republican Primary?
description:
This market will resolve according to the candidate who receives the third-most votes in the first round of the Republican Primary for United States Senator from Texas, which is scheduled to take place on March 3, 2026. 

If no 2026 Texas Republican Senate Primary takes place, this market will resolve to "Other".

The resolution source for this market will be the first announcement of the results from the Texas Republican party, however an overwhelming consensus of credible reporting may suffice.

subquestions.question: Will Donald Trump publicly endorse a candidate in the 2026 Texas Republican Senate primary before December 27, 2025?
subquestions.background_information:
The 2026 Texas Republican Senate primary, scheduled for March 3, 2026, features incumbent Senator John Cornyn, Attorney General Ken Paxton, and U.S. Representative Wesley Hunt. As of late November 2025, Donald Trump has not endorsed any candidate in this race. Trump's endorsement is widely considered a pivotal factor in Republican primaries, and in this three-way contest it could dramatically reshape the dynamics. Wesley Hunt has positioned himself as a staunch MAGA ally and was the first national figure to endorse Trump in 2024, while Paxton has also cultivated strong ties to Trump. Cornyn, backed by the Senate Republican establishment, has a more complicated relationship with Trump. Polling as of October-November 2025 shows Paxton and Cornyn each polling between 30-40%, with Hunt around 17-22%. A Trump endorsement of either Cornyn or Paxton could consolidate support and push Hunt further down, making a third-place finish more likely. Conversely, a Trump endorsement of Hunt could catapult him into serious contention and make a third-place finish less likely. The absence of an endorsement maintains the current three-way dynamic.

Sources:
- Yahoo News, 'Wesley Hunt Enters 2026 Texas Senate Race' (Oct 7, 2025): https://www.yahoo.com/news/wesley-hunt-enters-2026-texas-senate-race
- Yahoo News, 'Army veteran-turned-MAGA rising star jumps into fiery GOP Senate primary' (Oct 6, 2025): https://www.yahoo.com/news/army-veteran-turned-maga-rising-star-jumps-into-fiery-gop-senate-primary
- CBS News, 'Texas Sen. John Cornyn locked in close polling with AG Ken Paxton and Rep. Wesley Hunt' (Nov 16, 2025): https://www.cbsnews.com/texas/news/texas-sen-john-cornyn-locked-in-close-polling-with-ag-ken-paxton-and-rep-wesley-hunt/
- E&E News, 'Wesley Hunt launches Senate bid, scrambling Texas GOP primary' (Oct 7, 2025): https://www.eenews.net/articles/wesley-hunt-launches-senate-bid-scrambling-texas-gop-primary/
subquestions.resolution_criteria: This question resolves Yes if, between 2025-11-26 and 2025-12-26 (inclusive), Donald Trump makes a public endorsement of any candidate (John Cornyn, Ken Paxton, Wesley Hunt, or any other declared Republican candidate) in the 2026 Texas Republican Senate primary. A 'public endorsement' means a statement issued via Trump's official social media accounts (e.g., Truth Social), an official campaign or PAC press release, or a verbal endorsement at a public event or rally that is widely reported by credible news outlets (e.g., AP, Reuters, major U.S. newspapers, or major cable news networks). The endorsement must specifically name the Texas Senate race and a candidate. This question resolves No if no such public endorsement is made by 11:59 PM ET on December 26, 2025. Resolution will be based on reporting from major credible news outlets such as AP (https://apnews.com), Reuters (https://reuters.com), or the New York Times (https://nytimes.com).
subquestions.rationale: A Trump endorsement is arguably the single most consequential variable in this three-way Republican primary. If Trump endorses Cornyn or Paxton, it would likely consolidate conservative/MAGA support around that candidate and relegate Hunt to a distant third place, making the ultimate question ('Will Hunt come in 3rd?') more likely to resolve Yes. If Trump endorses Hunt, it could vault him into serious contention for first or second place, making 3rd place less likely. If Trump remains neutral, the current polling dynamics—where Hunt trails both Cornyn and Paxton significantly—persist, and Hunt's third-place finish remains the most probable outcome but not certain. Knowing whether Trump endorses (and whom) in the near term would significantly update forecasters' estimates on Hunt's final placement.

question: Fed governor resigns by October 31?
description:
This market will resolve to "Yes" if a Fed governor announces they have resigned or will resign between August 8 and October 31, 2025, 11:59 PM ET. Otherwise, this market will resolve to "No."

For this market to resolve to "Yes," it is only necessary that a governor announce that they have resigned or will resign. Whether they actually resign will have no bearing on the resolution of this market.

The primary resolution source for this market will be official information from the US federal government; however, a consensus of credible reporting will also be used.

subquestions.question: Will a federal court issue a ruling or injunction regarding President Trump's attempted removal of Fed Governor Lisa Cook before October 1, 2025?
subquestions.background_information:
On August 26, 2025, President Donald Trump posted a letter on Truth Social claiming he had fired Federal Reserve Governor Lisa Cook, citing allegations of mortgage fraud. Cook responded that Trump had 'no authority' to fire her and that she would not resign. She retained attorney Abbe Lowell, who indicated a lawsuit was forthcoming. On August 28, 2025, CNN reported that Trump followed through on firing Cook, making it the first time a president has removed a Fed governor. The legal question centers on whether the Federal Reserve Act permits presidential removal of governors only 'for cause' and whether the stated cause is legally sufficient. Cook's legal team has signaled they will challenge the removal in federal court. As of September 1, 2025, no court ruling has yet been issued on this matter.

The outcome of this legal battle is significant because if a court issues an injunction blocking Cook's removal, she would remain on the Board, making it less likely she would resign. Conversely, if a court upholds Trump's authority, Cook might face pressure to resign or accept the removal, potentially leading to a formal resignation announcement.

Sources:
- CNN: 'We just jumped into the unknown:' Inside Trump's attempt to put his mark on the Fed (August 28, 2025) https://www.cnn.com/2025/08/28/politics/trump-fed-lisa-cook
- CNBC Africa: Trump tells Fed's Lisa Cook she's fired; she says 'he has no authority to do so' (August 26, 2025) https://www.cnbcafrica.com/2025/08/26/trump-tells-feds-lisa-cook-shes-fired-she-says-he-has-no-authority-to-do-so/
- WTOP News: The Latest: Fed governor won't leave, saying Trump lacks authority to fire her (August 26, 2025) https://wtop.com/national/2025/08/the-latest-fed-governor-wont-leave-saying-trump-lacks-authority-to-fire-her/
subquestions.resolution_criteria: This question resolves Yes if, between 2025-09-01 and 2025-10-01 (inclusive), a U.S. federal court (district court, circuit court, or the Supreme Court) issues any substantive ruling, order, or injunction regarding the legality of President Trump's attempted removal of Federal Reserve Governor Lisa Cook. This includes temporary restraining orders, preliminary injunctions, or rulings on motions to dismiss. The question resolves No if no such ruling is issued by 2025-10-01. Resolution will be based on federal court dockets accessible via PACER (https://pacer.uscourts.gov/) or a consensus of credible reporting from sources such as Reuters (https://www.reuters.com/), the Associated Press (https://apnews.com/), CNN (https://www.cnn.com/), or CNBC (https://www.cnbc.com/). If no lawsuit is filed by Cook or her representatives during this period, the question resolves No.
subquestions.rationale: The legal battle over Trump's attempted removal of Lisa Cook is the central mechanism through which the ultimate question about a Fed governor resignation may be resolved. If a court rules in Cook's favor (e.g., issuing an injunction), she is very unlikely to resign, reducing the probability of the ultimate question resolving Yes. If a court upholds Trump's authority or declines to intervene, Cook may face increased pressure to resign or accept removal, increasing the probability. The speed and direction of judicial proceedings in September will be a strong early indicator of whether any Fed governor resignation announcement occurs before October 31. This question is distinct from the ultimate question because it asks about a judicial event rather than a resignation announcement, yet it is highly informative about the likely outcome.

question: Will Russia capture Lyman by November 30?
description:
This market will resolve to “Yes” if, according to the ISW map, Russia captures the Lyman railroad station located on Vulytsya Pryvokzalʹna by November 30, 2025, at 11:59 PM ET.

The railroad station will be considered captured if any part of the train station icon is shaded red on the ISW map (https://storymaps.arcgis.com/stories/36a7f6a6f5a9448496de641cf64bd375) by the resolution date. If the area is not shaded red by November 30, 2025, 11:59 PM ET, the market will resolve to “No”.

If Russia comes into control of this territory as a result of a negotiated settlement, this will qualify for a 'Yes' resolution, regardless of whether it is shaded red in the ISW map. An announcement of a negotiated settlement which gives Russia de jure control will not qualify. Actual control must be established.

Once Russia captures the railroad station, any subsequent loss of control will not be considered towards the resolution of this market.

subquestions.question: Will Russian forces capture or control territory within 5 km of Lyman's city center (Donetsk Oblast) according to the ISW map by November 15, 2025?
subquestions.background_information:
Lyman is a strategically important city in Donetsk Oblast, Ukraine, centered around a key railroad junction. As of mid-October 2025, the front line near Lyman has been relatively stable compared to more active sectors further south (e.g., Pokrovsk direction), but Russian forces have been conducting persistent offensive operations across the broader Donetsk and Kharkiv fronts. The ISW daily campaign assessment maps track Russian-controlled territory (shaded in red) and claimed advances. According to recent ISW reporting, Russian forces have been making incremental but steady gains across the eastern front. In June 2025, Russia made its largest monthly territorial advance since November, capturing 588 square kilometers (https://www.zerohedge.com/geopolitical/russia-army-captures-two-more-settlements-3rd-straight-month-advance-ukraines-east). However, Ukrainian forces have also conducted successful counterattacks in some sectors, including near Pokrovsk and in Dnipropetrovsk (https://charter97.org/en/news/2025/10/4/639614/). The Lyman area is currently contested, with Russian forces pushing from the east and south. Any significant advance toward Lyman—bringing Russian-controlled territory within 5 km of the city center—would be a strong precursor to an eventual assault on the city and its railroad station. The current front lines near Lyman can be tracked on the ISW interactive map (https://storymaps.arcgis.com/stories/36a7f6a6f5a9448496de641cf64bd375) and DeepStateMap (https://deepstatemap.live/).

Sources:
- ISW Interactive Map: https://storymaps.arcgis.com/stories/36a7f6a6f5a9448496de641cf64bd375
- DeepStateMap: https://deepstatemap.live/
- Zero Hedge (Jul 2025) on Russian advances: https://www.zerohedge.com/geopolitical/russia-army-captures-two-more-settlements-3rd-straight-month-advance-ukraines-east
- Charter97 (Oct 2025) on ISW assessments: https://charter97.org/en/news/2025/10/4/639614/
subquestions.resolution_criteria: This question resolves Yes if, at any point between 2025-10-22 and 2025-11-15 (inclusive), the ISW Ukraine interactive map (https://storymaps.arcgis.com/stories/36a7f6a6f5a9448496de641cf64bd375) shows Russian-controlled territory (shaded red) within approximately 5 km of the Lyman railroad station (located on Vulytsya Pryvokzalʹna, coordinates approximately 48.9875°N, 37.8133°E) that was NOT already shaded red as of 2025-10-22. This means there must be a NEW Russian advance bringing their controlled zone closer to the Lyman rail station compared to the baseline on October 22, 2025. If the ISW map is unavailable, the DeepStateMap (https://deepstatemap.live/) may be used as a fallback. The 5 km distance is measured as the straight-line distance from the nearest edge of newly red-shaded territory to the Lyman railroad station. If no discernible new Russian advance toward Lyman is visible on either map by November 15, 2025, the question resolves No. Temporary map glitches do not count.
subquestions.rationale: For Russia to capture the Lyman railroad station by November 30, 2025, Russian forces would need to make significant territorial gains in the approaches to the city in the weeks prior. Monitoring whether Russian forces advance closer to Lyman by mid-November serves as a leading indicator: if there is no meaningful forward movement toward Lyman by November 15, a capture of the railroad station by month's end becomes extremely unlikely. Conversely, a confirmed advance within 5 km would signal active operations targeting the city. This subquestion tracks a different observable—territorial proximity of the front line—rather than simply asking about the final capture with an earlier deadline.

question: Will BLɅϽKPIИK release an album by February 28?
description:
This market will resolve to “Yes” if Blackpink (블랙핑크, BLɅϽKPIИK) officially releases a new album by February 28, 2026, 11:59 PM PT (Los Angeles time). Otherwise, this market will resolve to “No”.

Officially released means that a newly released album is officially available for download or streaming (not including live events) by the resolution date.

The resolution source will be any official Blackpink streaming or download site, e.g. Apple Music or Spotify.

subquestions.question: Will YG Entertainment officially announce a specific release date for BLACKPINK's new album by January 7, 2026?
subquestions.background_information:
BLACKPINK has been widely reported to be working on a new full-length album. In November 2025, News18 reported that YG Entertainment confirmed the album is 'in the final stages for musical perfection' and suggested a January 2026 release (https://www.news18.com/entertainment/blackpinks-jennie-to-become-first-k-pop-artist-to-co-headline-spains-mad-cool-festival-2026-9120657.html). Jisoo stated in an ELLE Korea interview (November 2025) that the BLACKPINK album is scheduled for 'early 2026' (https://www.republicworld.com/entertainment/blackpink-vs-bts-in-2026-jisoos-statement-on-comeback-heats-up-discussions-about-possible-album-clash). However, as of late November 2025, YG Entertainment had not confirmed a specific release date, and the group's schedule has undergone multiple changes. The BLACKPINK DEADLINE World Tour is ongoing and concludes on January 26, 2026, in Hong Kong. Typically, K-pop agencies announce specific album release dates 2–4 weeks in advance, meaning an announcement by early January would be a strong indicator of a release before end of February 2026.

Sources:
- News18: https://www.news18.com/entertainment/blackpinks-jennie-to-become-first-k-pop-artist-to-co-headline-spains-mad-cool-festival-2026-9120657.html
- Republic World: https://www.republicworld.com/entertainment/blackpink-vs-bts-in-2026-jisoos-statement-on-comeback-heats-up-discussions-about-possible-album-clash
- Soompi (Jisoo ELLE interview): https://www.soompi.com/article/1685000wpp/blackpinks-jisoo-shares-her-plans-for-winter
- MoneyControl: https://www.moneycontrol.com/entertainment/blackpinks-jisoo-faces-backlash-over-comeback-comments-tied-to-bts-plans-article-12882811.html
subquestions.resolution_criteria: This question resolves Yes if, between 2025-12-08 and 2026-01-07 (inclusive), YG Entertainment or BLACKPINK's official channels (including but not limited to YG Entertainment's official website at https://www.ygfamily.com, BLACKPINK's official social media accounts on X/Twitter (@BLACKPINK), Instagram (@blackpinkofficial), or YouTube) publish an announcement specifying a concrete calendar date for the release of a new BLACKPINK group album (mini-album, EP, or full-length studio album). The announcement must name a specific date (not just a vague timeframe like 'early 2026' or 'Q1 2026'). If no such announcement is made by 11:59 PM UTC on January 7, 2026, the question resolves No. Unofficial leaks, rumors, or third-party reports without official confirmation do not count.
subquestions.rationale: A specific release date announcement is the most reliable leading indicator that an album will actually drop before February 28, 2026. K-pop albums are almost always preceded by official date announcements 2-4 weeks before release. If YG Entertainment announces a concrete date by early January, it is highly likely the album will be released by late February. Conversely, the absence of such an announcement by January 7 would signal potential further delays, making a February 2026 release less certain. This question captures a distinct, observable precursor event rather than simply asking the ultimate question earlier.

question: Will Silver (SI) hit (HIGH) $110 by end of June?
description:
This market will resolve to "Yes" if, on any trading day, the official CME settlement price for the Active Month (front month) of Silver (SI) futures is equal to or above the listed price by the final trading day of June 2026. Otherwise, the market will resolve to "No".

For CME Silver (SI) futures contracts, the Active Month is the nearest of CME's designated delivery-cycle months (March, May, July, September, December) that is not the spot month. The Active Month becomes a non-active month effective on its First Position Date, at which point the next eligible contract month becomes the Active Month.

Only the Active Month's official settlement price published by CME Group will be considered. Intraday trades, highs, lows, bids, offers, midpoint values, or indicative prices do not count.

Note that the settlement price may differ from the last traded price. CME's methodology to determine the settlement price can vary by commodity and contract.

Only days on which CME publishes an official settlement price for the Active Month will be included. Days without settlement prices (weekends, holidays, or market closures) are ignored.

This market will resolve based on the settlement price as it appears on the CME settlement page at the time it is first published for that trading day, regardless of any later corrections or updates.

The resolution source for this market is the CME Group website — specifically, the daily "Settlement" price for the Active Month of Silver (SI) futures.

subquestions.question: Will the CME Silver (SI) Active Month settlement price reach or exceed $70 per troy ounce on any trading day between 2025-12-27 and 2026-01-24?
subquestions.background_information:
Silver futures have been experiencing extraordinary volatility in late 2025. As of early December 2025, the front-month Silver (SI) contract settled around $59.22 (December 4, 2025 data), after a significant sell-off from historic highs reached in October 2025 when MCX silver peaked at Rs 1,67,663/kg. A dramatic event on November 28-29, 2025, saw silver futures trading halted during a record-breaking rally, reportedly tied to an unprecedented delivery request of approximately 400 million ounces of physical silver against COMEX, far exceeding available free float inventory. This event exposed structural tensions in the paper vs. physical silver market. The $70 level represents roughly an 18% move from early December levels, which would signal strong upward momentum. If silver cannot break convincingly above $70 in the near term, reaching $110 (roughly an 86% increase from ~$59) by end of June 2026 becomes significantly less probable. Conversely, if silver surges past $70 in January, it would indicate the kind of momentum and structural supply squeeze that could propel prices toward $110 within the following months. Key factors include the December 31, 2025 derivatives settlement deadline, Federal Reserve rate decisions, physical silver supply constraints, and dollar strength.

Sources:
- AP BC-Gold-Silver data, December 4, 2025: https://apnews.com
- CME Group Silver Futures Settlements: https://www.cmegroup.com/markets/metals/precious/silver.settlements.html
- Kitco Gold/Silver market commentary: https://www.kitco.com/news/article/2025-09-24/gold-futures-rally-continues-hitting-new-record-high-and-closing-price
subquestions.resolution_criteria: This question resolves Yes if, on any trading day between 2025-12-27 and 2026-01-24 (inclusive), the official CME Group daily settlement price for the Active Month of Silver (SI) futures is equal to or above $70.000 per troy ounce. The Active Month is defined as the nearest CME-designated delivery-cycle month (March, May, July, September, December) that is not the spot month, consistent with CME's active month conventions. Only the official settlement price published by CME Group on its settlement page (https://www.cmegroup.com/markets/metals/precious/silver.settlements.html) counts — intraday highs, lows, bids, offers, or indicative prices do not count. Days without published settlement prices (weekends, holidays, market closures) are ignored. If the settlement price reaches or exceeds $70.000 on any qualifying trading day within the window, this resolves Yes. Otherwise, it resolves No. If CME Group's settlement page is unavailable, the resolution may rely on archived CME data from reputable financial data providers such as Barchart (https://www.barchart.com/futures/quotes/SIH26/historical-download) or TradingView.
subquestions.rationale: For silver to reach $110 by end of June 2026, it would need to roughly double from recent levels around $59. The $70 threshold serves as a meaningful near-term waypoint: if silver cannot sustain upward momentum to reach even $70 in January 2026, a move to $110 within five additional months becomes much less plausible. Conversely, a rapid surge past $70 would confirm that the structural supply squeeze dynamics (physical delivery demands overwhelming COMEX inventory, the December 31 derivatives deadline aftermath, and potential short-covering cascades) are actively propelling prices higher. This makes the $70 level a genuine crux — forecasters who believe $110 is achievable should assign meaningfully higher probability to $70 being breached in January, while those skeptical of $110 would expect silver to remain below $70. The question tests momentum, supply-demand fundamentals, and market structure rather than simply restating the ultimate question with an earlier deadline.

question: Transgender women be banned from the Olympics before Winter Games?
description:
The next Olympics are scheduled to be held in Milan–Cortina from February 6 to 22, 2026. Recent reporting indicates the IOC is considering a ban on transgender women competing in the female category. You can read more about that here: https://www.theguardian.com/sport/2025/nov/10/ioc-edges-closer-to-ban-on-transgender-women-in-female-olympic-events.

This market will resolve to "Yes" if the International Olympic Committee (IOC) officially bans transgender women from competing in the female category by February 5, 2026, 11:59 PM ET. Otherwise, this market will resolve to "No".

A qualifying ban must affect at least one sport and apply to at least one clearly defined group, for example, transgender women who have undergone male puberty, individuals subject to specified testosterone-threshold policies, or athletes with differences of sexual development (DSD).

An official declaration of a qualifying ban within the specified timeframe will suffice, regardless of whether it is later revoked. 

Only IOC-imposed bans will qualify; bans or eligibility rules issued by other authorities, such as International Federations or National Olympic Committees, will not qualify. 

The primary resolution source for this market will be official IOC communications; however, a consensus of credible reporting will also be used.

subquestions.question: Will the IOC Executive Board hold a meeting or session before February 4, 2026, at which gender eligibility policy is on the formal agenda?
subquestions.background_information:
The IOC's 145th Session is scheduled for early February 2026 in Milan, just days before the Winter Olympics opening ceremony on February 6. IOC President Kirsty Coventry has stated she hopes to have a 'very clear decision' on protecting the female category by the first quarter of 2026, with a potential announcement at this session. As of late 2025, a working group established in June 2025 has been reviewing scientific findings from IOC Medical and Scientific Director Dr. Jane Thornton, which reportedly recommended barring athletes born male and those with differences of sexual development (DSD) from female Olympic events. No final decision has been made as of January 2026. The IOC Executive Board typically meets in advance of full IOC Sessions and can adopt or recommend policies. A key question is whether the Executive Board convenes before the Session and formally places gender eligibility on the agenda — a strong procedural signal that a ban could be formally adopted before the Winter Games.

The IOC's 145th Session is expected around February 3-5, 2026, per standard pre-Games scheduling. The Executive Board typically meets 1-2 days before the Session.

Sources:
- AP News (2025-12-10): IOC president Coventry sets early 2026 target for new Olympic policy on gender eligibility — https://apnews.com/article/ioc-transgender-athletes-gender-eligibility-olympics-coventry
- Irish Independent (2025-12-10): IOC president Kirsty Coventry says 'very clear decision' to protect female sport on way — https://www.independent.ie/sport/other-sports/olympics/were-trying-to-find-a-consensus-ioc-president-kirsty-coventry-says-very-clear-decision-to-protect-female-sport-on-way/a1595419077.html
- The Guardian (2025-11-10): IOC edges closer to ban on transgender women in female Olympic events — https://www.theguardian.com/sport/2025/nov/10/ioc-edges-closer-to-ban-on-transgender-women-in-female-olympic-events
subquestions.resolution_criteria: This question resolves Yes if, between 2026-01-13 and 2026-02-03 (inclusive), there is credible reporting or an official IOC communication confirming that the IOC Executive Board has held (or is scheduled to hold before February 4, 2026) a meeting at which transgender/gender eligibility policy for the female category is formally on the agenda. 'Formally on the agenda' means the topic is listed in the official meeting agenda, or credible reporting (e.g., from AP, Reuters, BBC, The Guardian, or the IOC's own website at https://www.olympic.org) confirms that the Executive Board discussed or is scheduled to discuss gender eligibility policy at that meeting. If no such meeting occurs or no credible reporting confirms the topic is on the agenda before February 4, 2026, this question resolves No. If the IOC Session itself (as opposed to the Executive Board) is the body that takes up the issue first, that also counts, provided it occurs before February 4, 2026.
subquestions.rationale: For the IOC to officially ban transgender women before the Winter Games (by February 5, 2026), the Executive Board or IOC Session must formally take up the policy. Knowing whether the topic is on the agenda of a pre-Games Executive Board meeting is a strong leading indicator: if gender eligibility is not even formally scheduled for discussion before the Games, it is very unlikely a ban will be enacted in time. Conversely, if it is on the agenda, the probability of a formal decision increases substantially. This is a procedural precursor that is distinct from the ultimate question (which asks about the ban itself) but highly informative about its likelihood.

question: Will Obama endorse Mamdani?
description:
This market will resolve to "Yes" if Barack Obama announces that he will vote for Zohran Mamdani or endorses Mamdani for the 2025 NYC Mayor election between June 25, and November 3, 2025, 11:59 PM ET. Otherwise this market will resolve to "No".

If Barack Obama announces that he will vote for another candidate or endorses another candidate for NYC Mayor, this market will immediately resolve to "No".

The resolution source for this market will be official information from Barack Obama or one of his representatives, or a consensus of credible reporting of Obama's endorsement.

subquestions.question: Will Senate Minority Leader Chuck Schumer or House Minority Leader Hakeem Jeffries publicly endorse Zohran Mamdani for NYC mayor before November 1, 2025?
subquestions.background_information:
As of late September 2025, several high-profile Democratic leaders have endorsed Zohran Mamdani for NYC mayor, including Governor Kathy Hochul (September 15), former Vice President Kamala Harris (September 23), and Senator Bernie Sanders (June 28). However, two of the most prominent New York Democratic leaders — Senate Minority Leader Chuck Schumer and House Minority Leader Hakeem Jeffries — have notably withheld their endorsements despite having met with Mamdani. Their reluctance has been widely reported as a signal of establishment Democratic hesitance toward Mamdani's democratic socialist candidacy. Former President Barack Obama spoke with Mamdani by phone in June 2025 but has not endorsed him, and the pattern of establishment endorsements (or lack thereof) has been a major storyline in the race. Obama has historically been cautious about endorsements in local races and tends to follow the broader party establishment's lead. If Schumer and Jeffries — the two highest-ranking New York Democrats in Congress — endorse Mamdani, it would signal that the Democratic establishment has fully consolidated behind him, making an Obama endorsement more plausible. Conversely, if they continue to withhold, it suggests the establishment remains fractured, and Obama would be unlikely to break from that pattern.

Sources:
- WKRC: Obama call boosts hopes in Zohran Mamdani's mayoral bid but endorsement remains uncertain (August 15, 2025): https://local12.com/news/nation-world/obama-call-boosts-hopes-in-zohran-mamdanis-mayoral-bid-but-endorsement-remains-uncertain
- News 12: Former Vice President Kamala Harris endorses Zohran Mamdani for NYC mayor (September 23, 2025): https://bronx.news12.com/former-vice-president-kamala-harris-endorses-zohran-mamdani-for-nyc-mayor
- The New Republic: The Democratic Establishment's Shunning of Mamdani Is Disqualifying (August 20, 2025): https://newrepublic.com/article/187000/democratic-establishment-shunning-mamdani-disqualifying
- Daily News: Mamdani declines to immediately back Hochul's reelection (September 15, 2025): https://www.nydailynews.com/2025/09/15/mamdani-declines-to-immediately-back-hochuls-reelection/
subquestions.resolution_criteria: This question resolves Yes if either Senate Minority Leader Chuck Schumer or House Minority Leader Hakeem Jeffries (or both) publicly endorse Zohran Mamdani for NYC mayor between 2025-10-01 and 2025-10-31 (inclusive). An endorsement counts if it is announced via an official statement, social media post from their verified accounts, press conference, or reported by at least two credible news outlets (e.g., New York Times, Washington Post, AP, Reuters, Politico, NY Daily News). The endorsement must explicitly state support for Mamdani's candidacy for NYC mayor. If neither Schumer nor Jeffries makes such an endorsement by 11:59 PM ET on October 31, 2025, this question resolves No. Resolution sources include official social media accounts of Schumer (https://twitter.com/SenSchumer) and Jeffries (https://twitter.com/RepJeffries), as well as credible news reporting from outlets such as the New York Times (https://www.nytimes.com), Politico (https://www.politico.com), and the Associated Press (https://apnews.com).
subquestions.rationale: Obama's endorsement behavior in local races typically follows the broader Democratic establishment consensus. Schumer and Jeffries are the two most senior New York Democrats in Congress, and their continued refusal to endorse Mamdani has been a major signal of establishment hesitance. If they endorse in October — the final full month before the November 4 election — it would indicate the Democratic Party has fully unified behind Mamdani, creating conditions where Obama might feel comfortable also endorsing. If they continue withholding, Obama is very unlikely to step out ahead of them. This subquestion tracks a different but highly correlated observable (congressional leadership endorsements) that serves as a leading indicator of whether Obama will endorse.

question: EU/NATO country announces peacekeeping force in Ukraine in 2025?
description:
This market will resolve to "Yes" if any NATO or EU member country officially announces that they will be sending troops to Ukraine as part of a peacekeeping force by December 31, 2025, 11:59 PM ET. Otherwise this market will resolve to “No”.

A qualifying announcement must be part of a formal agreement between a NATO or EU member country and another country or international organization or otherwise indicative of a formalized policy.

Announcements which are statements of intent, contingent, or otherwise are not indicative of a formalized policy will not count

The primary resolution source for this market will be official information from NATO, the EU, or member states of either entity, however a consensus of credible reporting will also be used.

subquestions.question: Will the UK, France, or any other EU/NATO member country formally present a detailed, country-specific troop commitment plan for a peacekeeping or reassurance force in Ukraine at an international summit or ministerial meeting between September 1 and September 30, 2025?
subquestions.background_information:
As of late August 2025, discussions about a European-led 'reassurance force' or peacekeeping contingent for Ukraine have intensified significantly. Bloomberg reported on August 19 that about 10 European countries are prepared to send troops to Ukraine once a peace deal is reached (https://meduza.io/en/news/2025/08/19/about-10-countries-ready-to-send-troops-to-ukraine-as-part-of-peace-agreement-bloomberg). On August 28, Euractiv reported that a 'Coalition of the Willing' including Australia, Belgium, Canada, Estonia, France, Lithuania, and the UK was preparing to outline a proposed reassurance force, with Ukrainian President Zelenskyy suggesting allies would finalize pledges 'this week' (https://www.euractiv.com/section/defence-and-security/news/whos-in-and-whos-out-of-ukraines-reassurance-force/). European leaders are discussing a 40-km buffer zone concept (https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2025/08/29/), and the U.S. has signaled willingness to provide intelligence and air defense assets as a 'strategic enabler' (https://kyivindependent.com/us-may-provide-intelligence-air-defense-assets-to-european-peacekeepers-in-ukraine-ft-reports/). Germany is debating internally whether to contribute troops, with Chancellor Merz hinting at inclusion but facing significant domestic opposition (https://english.aawsat.com/). However, no country has yet made a formal, binding announcement of troop deployment — all statements remain at the level of intent, willingness, or contingent planning. The UN General Assembly session opens on September 16, 2025, which could serve as a venue for such announcements. A formal presentation of specific troop numbers, deployment timelines, and operational details at a summit would represent a significant escalation from current discussions toward the kind of 'formalized policy' required by the ultimate question.

Sources:
- Meduza, Bloomberg report on 10 countries: https://meduza.io/en/news/2025/08/19/about-10-countries-ready-to-send-troops-to-ukraine-as-part-of-peace-agreement-bloomberg
- Euractiv, Coalition of the Willing: https://www.euractiv.com/section/defence-and-security/news/whos-in-and-whos-out-of-ukraines-reassurance-force/
- Kyiv Independent, US support: https://kyivindependent.com/us-may-provide-intelligence-air-defense-assets-to-european-peacekeepers-in-ukraine-ft-reports/
- Asharq Al-Awsat, German debate: https://english.aawsat.com/
- Responsible Statecraft, NATO involvement: https://responsiblestatecraft.org/nato-us-ukraine-security/
subquestions.resolution_criteria: This question resolves Yes if, between 2025-09-01 and 2025-09-30 (inclusive), any EU or NATO member country formally presents at an international summit, ministerial meeting, or official government-hosted conference a specific, detailed plan that includes (a) the contributing country's name, (b) a concrete troop number commitment (not a range or 'up to' figure), and (c) a proposed deployment timeline for a peacekeeping, reassurance, or security force in Ukraine. The plan must be presented as the country's own commitment, not merely a discussion document or proposal for others to consider. Statements of intent, conditional pledges ('we would send troops if...'), or ranges without firm commitments do not qualify. Resolution will be based on official government press releases, NATO communiqués (https://www.nato.int/cps/en/natohq/news.htm), EU Council conclusions (https://www.consilium.europa.eu/en/press/press-releases/), or a consensus of at least three credible international news sources (e.g., Reuters, BBC, Financial Times, AP). If no qualifying presentation occurs by 2025-09-30 23:59 UTC, the question resolves No.
subquestions.rationale: The ultimate question asks whether any EU/NATO country will formally announce a peacekeeping force deployment to Ukraine by end of 2025. The current state of play (as of September 1, 2025) shows intense discussions but no formal commitments. A key intermediate step between 'discussing willingness' and 'announcing deployment' is the formal presentation of specific, detailed troop commitment plans at international venues. September 2025 is a critical month because: (1) Zelenskyy indicated allies would finalize pledges imminently, (2) the UN General Assembly opens September 16 providing a high-profile venue, and (3) the Coalition of the Willing was reportedly preparing to outline its force 'next week' as of August 28. If countries present specific troop commitments at a summit in September, it would be a strong leading indicator that a formal deployment announcement will follow before year-end. Conversely, if September passes with only continued vague discussions, it signals the political and logistical barriers remain too high for a 2025 announcement.

question: Will another MrBeast video get 100m+ week 1 views by November 30?
description:
This market will resolve to "Yes" if any YouTube video posted by MrBeast gets over 100 million views in the first 7 days after being posted between September 25 and November 30, 2025 ET. Otherwise, this market will resolve to “No”.

If MrBeast does not post a YouTube video by November 30, 2025, 11:59 PM ET, this market will resolve to "No".

Videos posted within the final 7 days of this market's resolution date will qualify, and this market will remain open to allow for the full 7 days to be completed.

The resolution source for this market is MrBeast's YouTube channel (https://www.youtube.com/@MrBeast), specifically the 'views' counter for the described video.

Note: This market refers to MrBeast’s posted YouTube videos. Shorts, previews, or other videos released other than the referenced videos will not be considered.

subquestions.question: Will MrBeast upload a new long-form YouTube video (not a Short) between September 27, 2025 and October 27, 2025?
subquestions.background_information:
MrBeast (Jimmy Donaldson) is the most-subscribed individual creator on YouTube with approximately 437 million subscribers as of late September 2025. His upload cadence for long-form videos has varied significantly over the years; in some periods he uploads multiple videos per month, while in others he goes weeks without a new long-form upload. His most recent notable long-form content includes an NFL collaboration video ('I Bought the NFL') posted in early September 2025, which garnered around 9 million views (https://www.prweek.com/article/flag-football-the-tswift-balance-and-creator-cookouts-the-nfls-influencer-play-card). Meanwhile, MrBeast's Shorts content has surpassed his long-form content in total views (47.3 billion vs 46.6 billion as of August 2025), raising questions about whether his upload frequency for long-form videos may be shifting (https://www.dailydot.com/upstream/mrbeast-youtube-shorts-more-views-than-videos/). For a video to hit 100 million views in its first week, MrBeast first needs to actually upload a long-form video during the resolution window of the ultimate question. Tracking whether he uploads in the next month is a key prerequisite indicator.

Sources:
- The Daily Dot, 'MrBeast's YouTube shorts now have more views than his videos': https://www.dailydot.com/upstream/mrbeast-youtube-shorts-more-views-than-videos/
- PR Week, 'Flag football, the TSwift balance and creator cookouts': https://www.prweek.com/article/flag-football-the-tswift-balance-and-creator-cookouts-the-nfls-influencer-play-card
- MrBeast YouTube channel: https://www.youtube.com/@MrBeast
subquestions.resolution_criteria: This question resolves Yes if MrBeast uploads at least one new long-form YouTube video (defined as a standard upload, not a YouTube Short, preview, or community post) to his main channel (https://www.youtube.com/@MrBeast) between September 27, 2025 and October 27, 2025 (inclusive, UTC). The video must appear in the 'Videos' tab of the channel (not the 'Shorts' tab). Resolution is determined by checking MrBeast's YouTube channel (https://www.youtube.com/@MrBeast/videos) on or after October 27, 2025, to see if any new long-form video was published within this window. If no such video is published by 11:59 PM UTC on October 27, 2025, the question resolves No.
subquestions.rationale: A necessary condition for MrBeast to get 100 million views in one week by November 30 is that he actually uploads long-form videos during that period. If MrBeast is in an active upload phase (uploading at least one video in October), it signals he is likely to upload more videos in October-November, giving him more chances to hit the 100M threshold. If he doesn't upload any long-form video in the next month, that would significantly reduce the probability of the ultimate question resolving Yes, since there would be fewer total opportunities (only November would remain). This is a different observable from the ultimate question itself—it tracks upload activity rather than view counts—but is highly informative about the final outcome.

question: U.S. agrees to a new trade deal with "Argentina"?
description:
This market will resolve to "Yes" if a free trade agreement with the specified country or entity becomes law in the United States between July 25, and December 31, 2025, 11:59 PM ET. Th Otherwise, this market will resolve to "No".

This includes both agreements that become law through Senate ratification and Presidential approval, or through the enactment of a Congressional-Executive Agreement signed into law by the President.

The resolution source will be a consensus of credible reporting.

subquestions.question: Will the U.S. and Argentina announce the formal launch of bilateral free trade agreement negotiations between October 31 and November 30, 2025?
subquestions.background_information:
The ultimate question asks whether the U.S. will agree to a new trade deal with Argentina that becomes law by December 31, 2025. Currently, there is no U.S.-Argentina free trade agreement in place, nor are there any known formal bilateral FTA negotiations underway between the two countries. Argentina's President Javier Milei has cultivated a close relationship with U.S. President Donald Trump, and the U.S. Treasury announced a $20 billion currency swap with Argentina on October 9, 2025, signaling deepening economic ties (AS/COA, https://www.as-coa.org/articles/tracking-trump-and-latin-america-trade). However, FTA negotiations typically take years to complete — the EU-Mercosur deal took over 25 years of negotiations (POLITICO, https://www.politico.eu/article/brussels-aims-sign-mercosur-trade-deal-december-5/). Argentina is part of the Mercosur bloc (with Brazil, Paraguay, and Uruguay), which has been pursuing trade deals collectively with the EU and EFTA countries rather than bilaterally (BNN Bloomberg, https://www.bnnbloomberg.ca/business/international/2025/09/16/south-americas-mercosur-bloc-signs-trade-deal-with-four-european-countries/). For the U.S. to finalize an FTA with Argentina by end of 2025, formal negotiations would need to be announced imminently. No such announcement has been made as of October 31, 2025. The U.S. trade focus in Latin America has been on Mexico (extending tariff deadlines) and Brazil (50% tariffs and nascent deal talks), not Argentina specifically (The Straits Times, https://www.straitstimes.com/world/americas/mexico-s-sheinbaum-says-agreed-with-trump-to-extend-trade-deadline-for-a-few-more-weeks).

Sources:
- AS/COA, Tracking Trump and Latin America: Trade: https://www.as-coa.org/articles/tracking-trump-and-latin-america-trade
- POLITICO, Brussels aims to sign Mercosur trade deal on Dec. 5: https://www.politico.eu/article/brussels-aims-sign-mercosur-trade-deal-december-5/
- BNN Bloomberg, South America's Mercosur bloc signs trade deal with four European countries: https://www.bnnbloomberg.ca/business/international/2025/09/16/south-americas-mercosur-bloc-signs-trade-deal-with-four-european-countries/
- The Straits Times, Mexico's Sheinbaum says agreed with Trump to extend trade deadline: https://www.straitstimes.com/world/americas/mexico-s-sheinbaum-says-agreed-with-trump-to-extend-trade-deadline-for-a-few-more-weeks

question: U.S. enacts AI safety bill in 2025?
description:
This market will resolve to "Yes" if a bill that includes at least one of the following provisions is signed into federal law in the United States  by December 31, 2025, 11:59 PM ET. 

- Prohibition on Creation or Release: Forbids the creation or release of specific AI systems or models.

- Training Restrictions: Sets limits on how AI systems can be trained, such as restricting access to previously available training data or imposing a maximum limit on the number of parameters used for training.

- Usage Restrictions:  Prevents AI systems from being used in certain applications, such as interacting with customers, interfacing with other applications, or performing actions on the web.

- Human-in-the-Loop Requirements: Requires AI systems to include mechanisms ensuring human oversight or involvement in their operation.

Otherwise this market will resolve to "No". 

The resolution source will be official U.S. federal government (e.g., Congress.gov) however a consensus of credible reporting may also be used.

subquestions.question: Will the U.S. Senate or House hold a committee markup or floor vote on any federal AI safety bill between October 1, 2025, and October 31, 2025?
subquestions.background_information:
As of October 2025, the U.S. Congress has not enacted comprehensive federal AI safety legislation. Several AI-related bills have been introduced, including the AI Accountability and Personal Data Protection Act (Hawley-Blumenthal) and the No Adversarial AI Act (Krishnamoorthi-Moolenaar), but none has advanced through committee markup or received a floor vote. The Trump administration's AI Action Plan, released July 23, 2025, rescinds Biden-era AI safety measures and emphasizes deregulation and open-source AI promotion. A proposed 10-year moratorium on state-level AI regulation was stripped from the One Big Beautiful Bill Act after a 99-1 Senate vote, indicating bipartisan skepticism of blanket federal preemption but not necessarily momentum toward affirmative federal AI safety mandates. Meanwhile, states have been highly active: all 50 states introduced AI-related legislation in 2025, California signed its Transparency in Frontier Artificial Intelligence Act (SB 53) on September 30, 2025, and Texas, Illinois, Utah, and Nevada have all enacted AI-specific laws. Federal legislators like Senator Ted Cruz have called for a unified national framework rather than a patchwork of state laws, but Congress has yet to coalesce around a specific bill. For a federal AI safety bill to become law by December 31, 2025, it would need to clear committee, pass both chambers, and be signed by the president within approximately three months — a timeline that requires significant legislative momentum in October.

Sources:
- Lexology Q3 2025 AI Update: https://www.lexology.com/library/detail.aspx?g=quarterly-ai-update-q3-2025
- Meta AI Policies and State AI Regulation (Lexology, Aug 2025): https://www.lexology.com/library/detail.aspx?g=meta-platforms-ai-policies-investigation-states-ai-regulation
- California AI law (WZTV, Sep 30, 2025): https://fox17.com/news/nation-world/california-ai-law-could-pave-way-for-a-new-national-standard
- MSU Expert on State AI Guardrails (Newswise, Sep 13, 2025): https://www.newswise.com/articles/msu-expert-how-are-states-placing-guardrails-around-ai
- Congress.gov bill search for AI legislation: https://www.congress.gov/search?q=%7B%22source%22%3A%22legislation%22%2C%22search%22%3A%22artificial+intelligence+safety%22%7D
subquestions.resolution_criteria: This question resolves Yes if, between October 1, 2025, and October 31, 2025 (inclusive), any committee of the U.S. Senate or U.S. House of Representatives holds a formal markup session on, or either chamber holds a floor vote on, a bill that includes at least one of the following provisions: (a) prohibition on the creation or release of specific AI systems or models, (b) training restrictions on AI systems, (c) usage restrictions preventing AI systems from being used in certain applications, or (d) human-in-the-loop requirements for AI systems. The bill must be a standalone AI safety bill or a bill with a clearly identifiable AI safety title/section containing one or more of these provisions. Resolution will be determined by checking the official actions recorded on Congress.gov (https://www.congress.gov/) for any such bill. A committee markup is defined as a formal session where committee members debate and vote on amendments to a bill; a hearing alone does not count. If Congress.gov is unavailable, official records from the Senate (https://www.senate.gov/) or House (https://www.house.gov/) Clerk's office may be used as fallback sources. If no such markup or vote occurs by October 31, 2025, 11:59 PM ET, this question resolves No.
subquestions.rationale: For a federal AI safety bill to become law by December 31, 2025, it must advance through committee and floor votes in both chambers within the remaining legislative calendar. October is a critical month: if no committee markup or floor vote on an AI safety bill occurs in October, the window for enactment by year-end becomes extremely narrow given the Thanksgiving recess, end-of-year legislative crunch, and the need for bicameral agreement and presidential signature. A 'Yes' resolution would indicate meaningful legislative momentum, significantly raising the probability of enactment. A 'No' resolution would suggest the bill is unlikely to make it through the full legislative process in time, as Congress typically needs at least 2-3 months from markup to final passage for substantive legislation. This subquestion asks about a different, earlier observable event (committee markup or floor vote) rather than simply restating the ultimate question with a tighter deadline.

question: Major meteor strike (10kt+) in 2025?
description:
This market will resolve to "Yes" if a natural meteoroid (bolide) explodes in Earth's atmosphere with a total impact energy greater or equal to 10 kilotons of TNT equivalent between May 28, and December 31, 2025, 11:59 PM ET. Otherwise, this market will resolve to “No”.

The object must be classified as a natural meteoroid; events involving artificial objects or reentry vehicles do not qualify.

The primary resolution source will be the NASA JPL Fireball and Bolide Data repository: https://cneos.jpl.nasa.gov/fireballs/. The relevant field for determining impact energy is the “Impact Energy (kt)” column. If this dataset has not been updated to include all relevant dates by February 28, 2026, or if the NASA JPL Fireball and Bolide Data repository becomes permanently unavailable, this market may resolve based on a consensus of credible sources including the European Space Agency (ESA), the International Asteroid Warning Network (IAWN), the U.S. Department of Defense, or credible reporting of a scientific consensus, such as a NASA press release.

subquestions.question: Will at least 3 bolide events with impact energy ≥ 1 kiloton of TNT equivalent be recorded on the NASA JPL Fireball and Bolide Data repository between September 1 and September 30, 2025?
subquestions.background_information:
The ultimate question asks whether a natural meteoroid with impact energy ≥ 10 kilotons of TNT equivalent will strike Earth's atmosphere between May 28 and December 31, 2025. Events of that magnitude are very rare — the last well-known one above 10 kt was the Chelyabinsk airburst in February 2013 (~440 kt). However, smaller kiloton-class events occur more frequently and serve as indicators of the overall rate of bolide activity.

The NASA JPL Center for Near Earth Object Studies (CNEOS) maintains a publicly available Fireball and Bolide Data repository that logs bolide events detected by U.S. government sensors. According to this database, kiloton-class events (≥ 1 kt) occur roughly 2–5 times per year on average. In 2025, a notable 1.6-kiloton event was recorded over southern Japan on August 19, 2025 (https://watchers.news/2025/08/20/bright-fireball-with-impact-energy-of-1-6-kilotons-observed-over-southern-japan-on-august-19/). Other smaller events have also been recorded in 2025, such as the Georgia bolide on June 26 (~0.02 kt).

A month with an unusually high number of kiloton-class events would suggest an elevated rate of bolide activity, which — while not directly predictive — would slightly increase the probability of a much larger (10 kt+) event occurring before the end of 2025. The historical baseline from the CNEOS database shows that having 3 or more kiloton-class events in a single calendar month is uncommon but not impossible.

Sources:
- NASA JPL CNEOS Fireball and Bolide Data: https://cneos.jpl.nasa.gov/fireballs/
- Watchers.news report on August 19, 2025 Japan fireball: https://watchers.news/2025/08/20/bright-fireball-with-impact-energy-of-1-6-kilotons-observed-over-southern-japan-on-august-19/
- Brown et al. (2013), "A 500-kiloton airburst over Chelyabinsk and an enhanced hazard from small impactors", Nature: https://www.nature.com/articles/nature12741
subquestions.resolution_criteria: This question resolves Yes if at least 3 distinct bolide events, each with a reported 'Impact Energy (kt)' value of ≥ 1.0 kilotons of TNT equivalent, appear in the NASA JPL Fireball and Bolide Data repository (https://cneos.jpl.nasa.gov/fireballs/) with event dates between September 1, 2025 and September 30, 2025 (inclusive, UTC). Only events classified as natural meteoroids count; artificial reentry events do not qualify. The database should be checked no earlier than January 31, 2026, to allow for data processing delays. If the NASA JPL repository has not been updated to include September 2025 data by March 31, 2026, or becomes permanently unavailable, resolution may rely on equivalent data from the European Space Agency's Near-Earth Object Coordination Centre (https://neo.ssa.esa.int/) or published U.S. Department of Defense sensor reports. If fewer than 3 qualifying events are recorded in the specified window, the question resolves No.
subquestions.rationale: The rate of kiloton-class bolide events is an observable indicator of the overall flux of impactors entering Earth's atmosphere. While a 10 kt+ event is governed by a different (much rarer) portion of the size-frequency distribution, an anomalously active month for kiloton-class fireballs would be a weak but informative signal that the near-Earth environment is seeing elevated activity. This subquestion tracks a concrete, measurable proxy — the count of ≥1 kt fireballs in September 2025 — using the same authoritative data source (NASA CNEOS) as the ultimate question. A forecaster who believes 2025 is an unusually active year for bolide impacts would assign higher probabilities to both this subquestion and the ultimate question, making it a meaningful crux for disagreements about the 10 kt+ event likelihood.

question: Jon Stewart cancelled by December 31?
description:
This market will resolve to "Yes" if the listed person is no longer host of their respective show for any length of time between September 18, and December 31, 2025, 11:59 PM ET. Otherwise, this market will resolve to "No".

An announcement of this person's resignation or removal before this market's end date will immediately resolve this market to "Yes", regardless of when the announced resignation or removal goes into effect.

If the owning network or its parent company announces the show that the listed person hosts is cancelled within timeframe, this market will immediately resolve to "Yes".

subquestions.question: Will Paramount or Comedy Central publicly announce a renewal of Jon Stewart's Daily Show contract before October 19, 2025?
subquestions.background_information:
Jon Stewart returned to host The Daily Show in early 2024, but his current contract with Comedy Central/Paramount is reported to expire in December 2025. In August 2025, Comedy Central's new boss George Cheeks was asked about Stewart's contract renewal and gave a noncommittal answer, saying 'no decision had been made' and that it was 'day one' of the new company. This vague response raised concerns about the show's future. Meanwhile, Paramount has already announced the cancellation of The Late Show with Stephen Colbert (ending May 2026), and Stewart has been vocally critical of Paramount's corporate decisions, including the Colbert cancellation and perceived censorship. Stewart recently told his audience, 'I'm not giving in, I'm not going anywhere, I think,' but the qualifier at the end suggested uncertainty. On September 18, 2025, Stewart took over an extra hosting slot on The Daily Show in response to the Jimmy Kimmel suspension, further raising his profile but also potentially increasing friction with corporate leadership. If Paramount announces a renewal, it would strongly signal Stewart will not be cancelled by year-end; continued silence or leaked reports of stalled negotiations would be a warning sign.

Sources:
- ScreenRant, 'Daily Show Fans Beware: Colbert May Not Be The Only Late-Night Host On The Chopping Block' (2025-08-10): https://screenrant.com/daily-show-jon-stewart-contract-renewal-comedy-central/
- Deadline, 'The Daily Show's Jon Stewart Torches Paramount Over Colbert Axing' (2025-07-22): https://deadline.com/2025/07/jon-stewart-paramount-colbert-cancellation-daily-show-1236037892/
- The Hollywood Reporter, 'Jon Stewart Taking Over Daily Show Desk Tonight After Jimmy Kimmel Suspension' (2025-09-18): https://www.hollywoodreporter.com/tv/tv-news/jon-stewart-daily-show-thursday-jimmy-kimmel-1236012345/
subquestions.resolution_criteria: This question resolves Yes if, between 2025-09-19 and 2025-10-19 (inclusive), Paramount Global, Comedy Central, or Jon Stewart publicly announces (via press release, official social media, or on-air statement) that Stewart's contract to host The Daily Show has been renewed or extended beyond December 2025. 'Publicly announces' means the information must be confirmed by at least one of: (a) an official statement from Paramount, Comedy Central, or Stewart's representatives; or (b) credible reporting from at least two major entertainment trade outlets (e.g., Variety, The Hollywood Reporter, Deadline). If no such announcement is made by 11:59 PM ET on October 19, 2025, this question resolves No. If the announcement is ambiguous (e.g., stating negotiations are ongoing but no deal is confirmed), the question resolves No.
subquestions.rationale: Stewart's contract expiration in December 2025 is the central mechanism through which he could leave or be removed from The Daily Show. If Paramount announces a renewal before mid-October, it would be a strong signal that Stewart will not be cancelled by December 31, making the ultimate question much more likely to resolve No. Conversely, continued silence on renewal—especially given leadership's noncommittal posture and Stewart's escalating public criticism of Paramount—would increase the probability that Stewart's show is cancelled or that he departs. This subquestion tracks a concrete, observable event (a contract announcement) that is a leading indicator distinct from the ultimate question of whether Stewart is actually cancelled.

question: Will Trump meet with Elon Musk by March 31?
description:
This market will resolve to "Yes" if Donald Trump meets with Elon Musk between November 24, 2025 and 11:59 PM ET on the listed date. Otherwise, this market will resolve to "No".

A meeting is defined as any encounter where both the listed individual and Trump are present and interact with each other in person.

An exchange of words, handshake, direct conversation, or other clear personal interaction between the named individuals will qualify as a meeting. Merely standing in proximity, making eye contact, or being present in the same room or event without direct interaction will not qualify.

The resolution source will be a consensus of credible reporting.

subquestions.question: Will Trump and Musk be reported as attending the same public event (e.g., rally, gala, holiday gathering, or ceremony) between November 25, 2025, and December 25, 2025?
subquestions.background_information:
Donald Trump and Elon Musk had a public falling out in mid-2025 after Musk resigned from his role leading the Department of Government Efficiency (DOGE) in May 2025 and criticized the administration's fiscal policies. Trump responded by threatening to review Musk's government contracts. However, the two were reunited at the memorial service for Charlie Kirk on September 21, 2025, at State Farm Stadium in Glendale, Arizona. They were photographed shaking hands, sitting together, and conversing. A lip-reading expert reported that Trump told Musk, 'Let's find a way to resolve things and get back on track' and 'I've missed you.' Despite this, Trump downplayed the encounter on Air Force One, calling it 'nice' but not a reconciliation (Mediaite, September 22, 2025: https://www.mediaite.com/trump/trump-downplays-elon-musk-reunion-after-charlie-kirk-memorial-exchange/). Since the Kirk memorial, there have been no widely reported subsequent in-person meetings between Trump and Musk. The holiday season (Thanksgiving, Christmas, New Year's) often features galas, fundraisers, and social events in Mar-a-Lago and elsewhere that Trump attends, and these could create opportunities for them to be at the same event. Whether they attend the same event would be a strong leading indicator of whether they will have a direct in-person interaction (a 'meeting' as defined by the ultimate question) before March 31.

Sources:
- TheJournal.ie, 'Trump and Musk meet and shake hands at Charlie Kirk memorial,' September 21, 2025: https://www.thejournal.ie/trump-musk-charlie-kirk-memorial-6621382-Sep2025/
- Mediaite, 'Trump Downplays Elon Musk Reunion After Charlie Kirk Memorial Exchange,' September 22, 2025: https://www.mediaite.com/trump/trump-downplays-elon-musk-reunion-after-charlie-kirk-memorial-exchange/
- The Cut, 'Donald Trump and Elon Musk Chatted at Charlie Kirk's Funeral,' September 22, 2025: https://www.thecut.com/article/donald-trump-elon-musk-charlie-kirk-funeral.html
- Chosun.com, 'Trump and Musk Reconcile at Memorial Service,' September 22, 2025: https://www.chosun.com/
subquestions.resolution_criteria: This question resolves Yes if, between November 25, 2025, and December 25, 2025 (inclusive), credible media outlets (e.g., Reuters, AP, CNN, Fox News, BBC, or major national newspapers) report that both Donald Trump and Elon Musk attended the same public or private event — such as a rally, gala, holiday party, ceremony, fundraiser, or social gathering — during this period. They do not need to have directly interacted; co-attendance at the same event is sufficient. The event must be reported by at least two independent credible news sources. If no such reporting exists by December 25, 2025, the question resolves No. If reporting is ambiguous (e.g., they were at the same venue but at different times on different days), the question resolves No.
subquestions.rationale: The ultimate question asks whether Trump and Musk will meet (i.e., have a direct in-person interaction) by March 31. A key early indicator is whether they attend the same event during the holiday season. The holiday period from late November through December is filled with social events, galas, and gatherings — especially around Mar-a-Lago — where high-profile figures often cross paths. If Trump and Musk are at the same event, the probability of a qualifying direct interaction (handshake, conversation, etc.) rises dramatically. Conversely, if they avoid each other's events entirely through the holidays, it suggests the relationship remains strained and a meeting before March 31 becomes less certain. This subquestion is distinct from the ultimate question because it asks about co-attendance rather than direct interaction, and it covers a shorter, earlier time window.

question: Bolsonaro guilty?
description:
On March 26, the Brazilian Supreme Court ruled that Jair Bolsonaro will stand charges for an attempted coup. You can read more about that here: https://www.nytimes.com/2025/03/26/world/americas/brazil-bolsonaro-trial-coup-2022-elections.html

This market will resolve to "Yes" if Jair Bolsonaro is found guilty of any charges related to the coup attempt by February 28, 2026, 11:59 PM ET. Otherwise, this market will resolve to "No".

If Bolsonaro's charges are dismissed, end due to a plea agreement without an admission of guilt, or a mistrial is declared for the relevant charges, this market will resolve to "No".
