The Atlanta Federal Reserve's GDPNow model provides a running real-time estimate of U.S. real GDP growth for the current quarter based on incoming economic data. It is widely followed as an early indicator of the official BEA GDP advance estimate. As of late August 2025, Q2 2025 GDP was revised upward to 3.3% annualized growth, rebounding from a -0.5% Q1 contraction. However, economists have cautioned that the tariff-induced drag on imports (which artificially boosted Q2 GDP) may fade, and full-year growth could slow to around 1.5%. The GDPNow tracker updates frequently as key economic data releases (ISM manufacturing, jobs reports, retail sales, etc.) come in during September. A GDPNow reading in the 2.0%-3.0% range heading into October would suggest that Q3 growth is tracking near the 2.0%-2.5% window specified in the ultimate question, since GDPNow estimates tend to converge toward the actual advance estimate as the quarter progresses. The GDPNow model is published at: https://www.atlantafed.org/cqer/research/gdpnow

Sources:
- Atlanta Fed GDPNow: https://www.atlantafed.org/cqer/research/gdpnow
- BEA Q2 2025 GDP second estimate: https://www.bea.gov/data/gdp/gross-domestic-product
- Reuters on Q2 GDP revision and AI investment: https://www.zawya.com/en/economy/north-america/us-second-quarter-gdp-revised-higher-as-businesses-boost-investment-in-ai-y7ffjy1b
subquestions.resolution_criteria: This question resolves Yes if the Atlanta Fed GDPNow model's most recent estimate of Q3 2025 real GDP growth (seasonally adjusted annualized rate), as published on the Atlanta Fed GDPNow page (https://www.atlantafed.org/cqer/research/gdpnow), is at or above 2.0% and strictly below 3.0% as of the last update released between 2025-09-01 and 2025-10-01 (inclusive). The relevant estimate is the final GDPNow update published on or before October 1, 2025. If the estimate is exactly 2.0%, it resolves Yes. If it is exactly 3.0%, it resolves No (as that would be at the boundary of 3.0% or above). If the Atlanta Fed discontinues or suspends the GDPNow model during this period and no update is available, this question resolves as ambiguous/N/A.
subquestions.rationale: The GDPNow model is the single best real-time tracker of the official BEA GDP advance estimate. By early October, the GDPNow estimate will have incorporated most of the major Q3 data releases (employment, retail sales, trade balance, industrial production) and will be a strong predictor of the October 30 advance estimate. If two forecasters disagree on whether Q3 GDP growth will land in the 2.0%-2.5% range, the GDPNow reading as of October 1 provides critical evidence: a reading in the 2.0%-3.0% band would indicate that the 2.0%-2.5% outcome is plausible but not certain, while a reading well above 3.0% or below 2.0% would strongly update against that bracket. The slightly wider 2.0%-3.0% range for the subquestion (vs. the ultimate question's 2.0%-2.5%) accounts for the fact that GDPNow still has some revision potential in October and avoids producing an uninformatively low probability.

question: GTA 6 launch postponed?
description:
This market will resolve to "Yes" if by May 26, 2026, 11:59 PM ET, Rockstar Games or its parent company, Take-Two Interactive, officially announces that Grand Theft Auto VI (GTA VI) will not be released by May 26, 2026. Otherwise, this market will resolve to "No".

If Grand Theft Auto VI is otherwise not released in the US by May 26, 2026, 11:59 PM ET this will qualify as a postponement.

For the purposes of this market, "release" refers to the game becoming publicly available for purchase or download in the US. Early access, beta versions, other forms of pre-release availability, or leaks will not count as an official release. If the release is only for certain consoles (e.g. Xbox Series X/S) it will count.

The resolution source will be official information from Rockstar Games or its parent company, Take-Two Interactive.

subquestions.question: Will Take-Two Interactive announce or hint at a delay of GTA VI's May 26, 2026 release date during its Q2 FY2026 earnings call or related investor communications in October or November 2025?
subquestions.background_information:
Take-Two Interactive, the parent company of Rockstar Games, is expected to hold its Q2 FY2026 earnings call in early November 2025 (typically the first or second week of November). Industry insider Tom Henderson of Insider Gaming has specifically predicted that a GTA VI delay announcement will come during this November earnings call, pushing the game from May 2026 to around October 2026 (https://gameranx.com/features/id/527889/article/insider-believes-a-grand-theft-auto-vi-delay-announcement-will-come-this-november/). However, as of late September 2025, Take-Two has repeatedly confirmed the May 26, 2026 release date — at its Annual Meeting of Shareholders on September 18, 2025, on the game's official website, and in CEO Strauss Zelnick's public statements (https://gameranx.com/features/id/528553/article/gta-6-still-on-schedule-for-may-2026-take-two-promises-more-details-in-the-future/). Bloomberg reporter Jason Schreier has also noted that 'there's no guarantee that May 2026 is a sure thing' (https://mashable.com/article/gta-vi-delay-what-we-know). Take-Two typically files preliminary earnings materials (such as press releases and investor letters) on or around the earnings call date, and sometimes issues pre-announcements or guidance updates before the call. Any indication — such as language changes on the official website, removal of the specific May 26 date, SEC filings adjusting Fiscal Year 2027 guidance, or pre-earnings press releases — would serve as early warning signals of a delay.

Sources:
- Gameranx (Sep 15, 2025): https://gameranx.com/features/id/527889/article/insider-believes-a-grand-theft-auto-vi-delay-announcement-will-come-this-november/
- Gameranx (Sep 19, 2025): https://gameranx.com/features/id/528553/article/gta-6-still-on-schedule-for-may-2026-take-two-promises-more-details-in-the-future/
- Mashable (Sep 20, 2025): https://mashable.com/article/gta-vi-delay-what-we-know
- Rockstar Games GTA VI official page: https://www.rockstargames.com/VI
- Take-Two Interactive investor relations: https://ir.take2games.com/
subquestions.resolution_criteria: This question resolves Yes if, between 2025-10-01 and 2025-10-31 (inclusive), any of the following occur: (1) Take-Two Interactive or Rockstar Games issues an official statement, press release, SEC filing, investor letter, or earnings-related communication indicating that GTA VI will not launch on May 26, 2026, or that the release date has been changed to a later date; OR (2) The official GTA VI website (https://www.rockstargames.com/VI) removes or changes the 'Coming May 26, 2026' language to a later date or a vaguer timeframe (e.g., 'Coming 2026' without specifying May 26); OR (3) Take-Two Interactive files an SEC document (e.g., 8-K, 10-Q, or investor presentation) that no longer references a May 26, 2026 launch date or references a different launch window. The question resolves No if none of the above occur by 11:59 PM ET on October 31, 2025. Resolution sources: the Rockstar Games official website (https://www.rockstargames.com/VI), Take-Two Interactive's investor relations page (https://ir.take2games.com/), and SEC filings via EDGAR (https://www.sec.gov/cgi-bin/browse-edgar?action=getcompany&CIK=0000946581&type=&dateb=&owner=include&count=40).
subquestions.rationale: The insider prediction of a delay announcement specifically targets November 2025, but any pre-announcement activity — such as changes to the official website, SEC filings adjusting guidance, or early communications from Take-Two — would likely appear in October as the company prepares for earnings. If Take-Two signals a delay in October, it is very strong evidence that GTA VI will be postponed past May 26, 2026 (resolving the ultimate question Yes). Conversely, if Take-Two continues to maintain the May 26, 2026 date through October without any wavering, it reduces (but does not eliminate) the probability of a delay being announced before November 6, 2025. This subquestion captures the most likely early indicator channel — official corporate communications — rather than relying on insider rumors.

question: Will US GDP growth in 2025 be between 2.0% and 2.5%?
description:
This market will resolve according to the seasonally adjusted real GDP growth rate for the United States in 2025, as reported in the Bureau of Economic Analysis (BEA) "Advance Estimate" release for Q4 of 2025, scheduled for January 29, 2026.

If the reported value falls exactly between two brackets, then this market will resolve to the higher range bracket.

The GDP release will be made available here: https://www.bea.gov/data/gdp/gross-domestic-product

Note: The relevant data will be the full-year real GDP growth rate as stated in the advance estimate, typically expressed as the percentage change from the annual level in 2024 to the annual level in 2025. Any revisions to this figure made after the release of the advance estimate will not be considered for this market's resolution.

subquestions.question: Will the BEA's final Q3 2025 GDP estimate (released January 22, 2026) show annualized quarterly growth of 4.0% or higher?
subquestions.background_information:
The BEA released its initial estimate of Q3 2025 real GDP growth on December 23, 2025, reporting an annualized rate of 4.3%, well above the consensus forecast of 3.3%. This followed Q2 2025 growth of 3.8% and a Q1 2025 contraction of 0.6%. The BEA noted that the first three quarters of 2025 averaged approximately 2.5% annualized growth. The final (third) estimate for Q3 2025 is scheduled for January 22, 2026. Historical analysis shows that GDP revisions from the advance/initial release to the final release average about 0.65 percentage points, meaning the final Q3 figure could plausibly range from roughly 3.0% to 5.6%. The Q3 figure is critical for full-year 2025 GDP calculations: a strong Q3 raises the annual average GDP level and makes it more likely that full-year 2025 growth falls within or above the 2.0%–2.5% range. Conversely, a significant downward revision to Q3 could pull full-year growth below 2.0%. Given that Q1 contracted and Q2/Q3 were strong, the exact magnitude of Q3 growth is a key input into whether full-year 2025 growth lands in the 2.0%–2.5% bracket.

Sources:
- Fox Business, 'US economy grew much faster than expected in the third quarter': https://www.foxbusiness.com/economy/us-economy-grew-much-faster-than-expected-third-quarter-delayed-report-shows
- TalkMarkets, '2025Q3 4.3% q/q AR Growth In Context': https://talkmarkets.com/content/us-markets/2025q3-43-qq-ar-growth-in-context?post=438210
- BEA GDP data page: https://www.bea.gov/data/gdp/gross-domestic-product
subquestions.resolution_criteria: This question resolves Yes if the Bureau of Economic Analysis (BEA) releases its final (third) estimate for Q3 2025 real GDP on or before January 29, 2026, and that estimate shows a seasonally adjusted annualized quarterly growth rate of 4.0% or higher. The relevant release is scheduled for January 22, 2026, and will be available at https://www.bea.gov/data/gdp/gross-domestic-product. The resolution window is between 2025-12-30 and 2026-01-29 (inclusive). If the BEA does not release the final Q3 2025 GDP estimate by January 29, 2026 (e.g., due to a government shutdown or other delay), this question resolves as ambiguous/unresolvable. The figure used is the headline real GDP percentage change (annualized quarterly rate) as stated in the BEA release. A figure of exactly 4.0% resolves Yes.
subquestions.rationale: The full-year 2025 GDP growth rate is computed from the annual average GDP levels across all four quarters. With Q1 2025 contracting by 0.6% and Q2 growing at 3.8%, the Q3 figure is a crucial determinant of the annual average. The initial Q3 estimate of 4.3% already implies strong momentum, but historical revision patterns suggest non-trivial probability of a downward revision. If Q3 is revised down significantly below 4.0%, it would lower the full-year average and could push 2025 annual growth below 2.0%, or alternatively, a sustained high Q3 figure combined with moderate Q4 growth could push the annual figure above 2.5%. This subquestion helps forecasters calibrate whether the strong Q3 number holds up, which directly feeds into the full-year calculation that the ultimate question depends on.

question: Will Tulsi Gabbard be the first to leave the Trump Cabinet before 2027?
description:
This market will resolve based on the next individual announced to leave the Trump Cabinet, or who otherwise ceases to be a member of the administration. If no one leaves by December 31, 2026, 11:59 PM ET, this market will resolve to “None before 2027”.

An announcement of an individual's resignation/removal before this market's end date will immediately resolve this market to "Yes", regardless of when the resignation/removal takes effect.

If multiple individuals announce departures or are removed at the same time, the market will resolve to the individual who actually leaves office first. If they leave simultaneously, the market will resolve to the individual whose last name comes first alphabetically.

For the purposes of this market, the Cabinet includes Vice President, the heads of the 15 executive departments, as well as the Administrator of the Environmental Protection Agency (EPA), the President’s Chief of Staff, the Director of National Intelligence (DNI), the Director of the Office of Management and Budget (OMB), the Director of the Central Intelligence Agency (CIA), the United States Trade Representative (USTR), the Ambassador to the United Nations, the Chair of the Council of Economic Advisers (CEA), and the Administrator of the Small Business Administration (SBA). Acting officials serving in these roles are not included. The Director of the Office of Science and Technology Policy (OSTP) is not considered Cabinet-level under the current Trump administration and is excluded from this market.

An individual will be considered to have left the Cabinet if they resign from or are removed from any Cabinet-level position, even if they are subsequently appointed to a different Cabinet-level role.

If a candidate who is not already listed, assumes a listed cabinet position they will be added to the market. However, candidates who have merely been nominated for a cabinet position will not be considered to have left, even if their nomination is rejected or withdrawn.

The primary resolution source will be official information from the Trump administration, however a consensus of credible reopening may also be used.

subquestions.question: Will Kristi Noem cease to serve as Secretary of Homeland Security between January 5, 2026, and February 1, 2026?
subquestions.background_information:
Multiple reports from late 2025 indicate that Homeland Security Secretary Kristi Noem is on 'thin ice' and may be removed from her position. A December 7, 2025, report from The Bulwark cited three former DHS officials (two of whom served under both Biden and Trump and remain in contact with current staff) saying that Trump is considering replacing Noem, with two believing the move could happen imminently. Key factors cited include frustration among top White House officials over Noem's continued employment of controversial adviser Corey Lewandowski, Trump's desire for a 'clean slate' at the start of 2026 to improve the execution of his mass deportation policy, and the possible availability of a prominent Republican governor with strong MAGA credentials. A December 15, 2025, Washington Post analysis noted Noem is on 'thin ice' and is 'expected to be replaced in 2026.' Separately, Noem faces speculation over a rumored romantic affair with a co-worker. However, Trump has been reluctant to fire Cabinet members in his second term, partly due to narrow Senate confirmations that make replacements politically difficult, and partly due to his unwillingness to admit mistakes. As of January 5, 2026, Noem remains in her position.

Sources:
- Raw Story, 'Key Trump Cabinet member to be booted from admin really soon: report' (Dec 7, 2025): https://www.rawstory.com/kristi-noem-2670547012/
- Raw Story, 'Trump's embarrassment has left him stuck with dead beat Cabinet: analysis' (Dec 15, 2025): https://www.rawstory.com/trump-cabinet-turnover/
- Alternet, 'The MAGA coalition is fraying — both inside and outside the White House: WaPo' (Dec 15, 2025): https://www.alternet.org/maga-coalition-fraying/
subquestions.resolution_criteria:
This question resolves Yes if Kristi Noem resigns, is fired, or otherwise ceases to serve as Secretary of Homeland Security between January 5, 2026, and February 1, 2026 (inclusive). An official announcement of her resignation or removal during this window is sufficient for resolution, even if her actual departure date falls after February 1, 2026. Resolution will be based on official White House statements, DHS announcements, or a consensus of credible major news sources (e.g., AP, Reuters, New York Times, Washington Post). If no such announcement is made by 11:59 PM ET on February 1, 2026, this question resolves No.

Sources for resolution:
- White House official statements: https://www.whitehouse.gov/briefing-room/
- Department of Homeland Security: https://www.dhs.gov/news
- Associated Press: https://apnews.com/
- Reuters: https://www.reuters.com/
subquestions.rationale: Kristi Noem is the Cabinet member most widely reported to be at risk of imminent departure. If she leaves before Tulsi Gabbard, the ultimate question ('Will Tulsi Gabbard be the first to leave the Trump Cabinet before 2027?') would resolve No. Multiple credible reports from December 2025 suggest Noem's departure could happen in early 2026. Tracking whether Noem actually departs is a key crux: forecasters who believe Gabbard will be the first to leave must implicitly believe Noem will survive longer, while those who think Gabbard won't be first likely expect Noem to go sooner. This subquestion directly tests that disagreement by monitoring the most probable alternative first departure.

question: Will MrBeast post another video on a weekday by September 30?
description:
On August 1, 2025, a Friday, MrBeast posted a video on his main YouTube channel, which breaks his usual pattern (https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Z4hVGCWH1Kc).

This market will resolve to “Yes” if MrBeast posts a YouTube video on a weekday (Monday - Friday, ET) between August 19 and September 30, 2025, 11:59 PM ET. Otherwise, this market will resolve to “No”.

The resolution source for this market is MrBeast's main YouTube channel (https://www.youtube.com/@MrBeast).

Note: This market refers to MrBeast's regular posted videos. Shorts, previews, or videos on platforms other than YouTube will not be considered.

subquestions.question: Will MrBeast upload at least one regular (non-Shorts) video to his main YouTube channel between September 1 and September 14, 2025?
subquestions.background_information:
MrBeast (Jimmy Donaldson) is the most-subscribed individual creator on YouTube, with a prolific upload schedule on his main channel (https://www.youtube.com/@MrBeast). Historically, MrBeast has posted videos on weekends (typically Saturdays), but on August 1, 2025 — a Friday — he broke that pattern by uploading a video (https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Z4hVGCWH1Kc). He has been extremely active in August 2025: he launched the #TeamWater campaign on August 1, broke a charity livestream record on August 14 raising $12 million (https://www.forbes.com/sites/), wrapped filming for Beast Games Season 2 announced on August 27 (https://www.yahoo.com/entertainment/mrbeast-promises-season-2-prime-video-show-beast-games-10x-better-unveils-first-look), and offered a $100,000 bounty related to a TeamWater scam on August 31 (https://www.sportskeeda.com/). Given this high level of activity and content production, tracking whether MrBeast uploads any video in early September provides a strong signal about his overall upload cadence during the resolution window of the ultimate question. If he uploads at least one video in the first two weeks of September, it increases the likelihood that at least one of those uploads will fall on a weekday (Monday–Friday ET).

Sources:
- MrBeast's main YouTube channel: https://www.youtube.com/@MrBeast
- Forbes on MrBeast charity record: https://www.forbes.com/sites/
- Yahoo on Beast Games Season 2: https://www.yahoo.com/entertainment/mrbeast-promises-season-2-prime-video-show-beast-games-10x-better-unveils-first-look
- Sportskeeda on TeamWater scam bounty: https://www.sportskeeda.com/
subquestions.resolution_criteria: This question resolves Yes if MrBeast uploads at least one regular (non-Shorts, non-preview, non-livestream-only) video to his main YouTube channel (https://www.youtube.com/@MrBeast) between September 1, 2025, and September 14, 2025 (inclusive, using the upload date shown on YouTube). It resolves No if no such video appears during that window. Shorts, YouTube Premieres that are only teasers/previews, and livestream-only content do not count. The primary resolution source is MrBeast's main YouTube channel videos tab: https://www.youtube.com/@MrBeast/videos. If YouTube is unavailable, archived screenshots or third-party YouTube tracking tools (e.g., Social Blade at https://socialblade.com/youtube/channel/UCX6OQ3DkcsbYNE6H8uQQuVA) may be used as fallback sources.
subquestions.rationale: The ultimate question asks whether MrBeast will post a video on a weekday (Mon–Fri ET) before September 30. A key prerequisite is that MrBeast actually uploads videos during this period. If he uploads at least one video in the first two weeks of September, it substantially increases the chance that one of those uploads lands on a weekday. Conversely, if he goes completely silent on uploads for two weeks, it would be a notable departure from his recent prolific activity and would lower confidence in a weekday upload occurring before the deadline. This subquestion tracks upload activity as an early indicator rather than simply restating the weekday condition.

question: Will the US capture Khamenei before 2027?
description:
This market will resolve to "Yes" if U.S. government personnel (including U.S. military, CIA, or any U.S. federal law enforcement agency) directly participate on the ground in an operation that results in the capture of Supreme Leader of Iran Ali Khamenei by December 31, 2026, 11:59 PM ET. Otherwise, this market will resolve to "No".

For the purposes of this market, “capture” means Khamenei is taken into physical custody and detained (including arrest, detention, or seizure) such that he is no longer free to leave at will, even if only temporarily. Voluntary surrender may qualify if it results in immediate detention/custody.

U.S. personnel must directly participate on the ground to qualify. Intelligence, surveillance, planning, logistics, transport, support, funding, training, or advisory roles alone will not count, even if they materially contribute to the operation. If U.S. personnel are physically present in the operational area and take direct action (e.g., raiding, detaining, securing, physically transferring custody), it will qualify. U.S. government contractors will be considered to be U.S. personnel if they are confirmed to be acting under the direction of U.S. government authorities.

The primary resolution source for this market will be a consensus of credible reporting.

subquestions.question: Will the US conduct any acknowledged military strike on Iranian territory between 2026-02-08 and 2026-02-26?
subquestions.background_information:
As of early February 2026, the US has deployed a large naval armada to the Middle East, including the USS Abraham Lincoln carrier strike group and supporting assets, amid escalating tensions over Iran's violent crackdown on anti-government protests that began in late December 2025. President Trump has repeatedly threatened military action against Iran, and analysts have discussed options ranging from conventional strikes on IRGC facilities to targeted operations against leadership. Iran's Supreme Leader Ayatollah Ali Khamenei has warned that any attack would trigger a 'regional war' and is reportedly sheltering in underground bunkers beneath Tehran. Gulf allies have attempted diplomatic de-escalation, and both sides have confirmed open communication channels. However, no US military strikes on Iranian soil have occurred as of February 8, 2026. Any US military strike on Iranian territory would be a necessary precursor or concurrent event to any ground operation that could result in the capture of Khamenei — a capture operation cannot plausibly occur without first establishing some form of military engagement with Iran.

Sources:
- Al Jazeera, "Khamenei warns US of 'regional war' if Iran is attacked" (2026-02-01): https://www.aljazeera.com
- The Mirror, "US 'war-machine' armada lurks in Middle East as Iran on 'high alert'" (2026-01-27): https://www.mirror.co.uk
- Republic World, "Khamenei Reportedly Sheltering in Underground Bunker" (2026-01-25): https://www.republicworld.com
- inews.co.uk, "Operation Khamenei: How Trump could hunt down and kill Iran's Supreme Leader" (2026-02-04): https://inews.co.uk
- CBS News, "Trump told Iranian protesters 'help is on its way'" (2026-01-14): https://www.cbsnews.com
subquestions.resolution_criteria:
This question resolves Yes if, between 2026-02-08 and 2026-02-26 (inclusive), credible reporting from at least two major international news outlets (e.g., Reuters, AP, BBC, CNN, Al Jazeera, New York Times, Washington Post) confirms that the United States military conducted at least one kinetic strike (missile, airstrike, bombing, or other use of military weapons) on targets located within the internationally recognized borders of Iran (including Iranian airspace and territorial waters). The strike must be acknowledged or confirmed by official US government sources (such as the Department of Defense, White House, or CENTCOM) or independently verified by multiple credible media organizations. Covert operations that are not publicly confirmed or reported by the end date do not count. Cyberattacks alone do not count. Strikes on Iranian proxy forces outside Iran's borders do not count. If no such strike is confirmed by 2026-02-26, this question resolves No.

Primary resolution sources:
- Reuters: https://www.reuters.com
- Associated Press: https://apnews.com
- US Department of Defense press releases: https://www.defense.gov/News/
- US CENTCOM: https://www.centcom.mil/
subquestions.rationale: Capturing Khamenei requires US ground forces operating inside Iran, which is virtually impossible without a preceding or concurrent military engagement. A US military strike on Iranian territory would be the most significant escalatory step toward any scenario in which Khamenei could be captured. If no US strikes occur on Iranian soil during this window, it is extremely unlikely that a capture operation — which would require even deeper military commitment — could occur before March 1, 2027, let alone by the ultimate question's deadline. This subquestion thus serves as a critical early indicator: if it resolves No, the ultimate question almost certainly resolves No as well.

question: Will NewJeans perform again in 2025?
description:
This market will resolve to "Yes" if NewJeans (뉴진스, NJZ) gives at least one live performance as a group at any point between June 3 and December 31, 2025, 11:59 PM ET. A qualifying performance must involve at least three members of NewJeans performing together under the group name "NewJeans" in front of a live audience or as part of a livestreamed or televised event.

Prerecorded performances aired in 2025 that were filmed earlier will not count. Solo or sub-unit performances will not count. Dance practices or behind-the-scenes content do not qualify as performances for this market.

The resolution source will be official announcements from NewJeans (including verified social media) and ADOR, however a consensus of credible reporting will also be used.

subquestions.question: Will NewJeans (or their representatives) file a formal appeal of the October 30, 2025 Seoul Central District Court ruling by November 30, 2025?
subquestions.background_information:
On October 30, 2025, the Seoul Central District Court ruled that NewJeans' exclusive contracts with ADOR remain valid until 2029, rejecting the members' attempt to terminate the agreements. The court found that ADOR had not neglected its management obligations and that the dismissal of former CEO Min Hee-jin did not invalidate the contracts. Immediately after the ruling, NewJeans' legal representatives at Shin & Kim LLC announced the members intend to appeal, citing a 'complete breakdown' of trust with ADOR and stating it is impossible to continue activities under the current conditions.

Under South Korean civil procedure, an appeal of a district court ruling must generally be filed within two weeks of the judgment being served on the parties. Given the ruling was issued on October 30, 2025, the appeal window would likely fall within November 2025. Whether NewJeans actually files the appeal (as opposed to merely announcing intent) is a meaningful indicator: if they proceed with the appeal, the legal dispute remains unresolved and performing under the NewJeans name with ADOR's cooperation becomes less likely in the near term. If they do not appeal, it could signal a potential path toward reconciliation and resumed group activities under ADOR.

Sources:
- Soompi: Court Rules NewJeans' Contracts With ADOR To Be Valid + Members To Appeal Decision (October 30, 2025) https://www.soompi.com/article/1724021wpp/court-rules-newjeans-contracts-with-ador-to-be-valid-members-to-appeal-decision
- NME: South Korean court rules NewJeans must honour ADOR's contract until 2029 (October 30, 2025) https://www.nme.com/news/music/south-korean-court-rules-newjeans-must-honour-adors-contract-until-2029-3841234
- Yahoo: K-pop group NewJeans loses legal battle against agency (October 30, 2025) https://www.yahoo.com/entertainment/k-pop-group-newjeans-loses-legal-battle-against-agency-120000123.html
subquestions.resolution_criteria: This question resolves Yes if, between 2025-10-31 and 2025-11-30 (inclusive), NewJeans' members or their legal representatives formally file an appeal of the October 30, 2025 Seoul Central District Court ruling (Case regarding confirmation of the validity of exclusive contracts between ADOR and the five NewJeans members) with the Seoul High Court or the appropriate appellate court. Resolution is based on credible Korean media reports (e.g., Soompi at https://www.soompi.com, Koreaboo at https://www.koreaboo.com, Yonhap News at https://en.yna.co.kr), official court records, or official statements from the legal representatives of either party confirming that the appeal has been formally filed (not merely announced as an intention). If no credible reporting confirms a formal appeal filing by November 30, 2025, the question resolves No.
subquestions.rationale: Whether NewJeans formally appeals the court ruling is a critical near-term indicator for the ultimate question. If they appeal, the legal battle continues and the group remains in limbo—unable to perform independently (due to the injunction) and unlikely to cooperate with ADOR (due to the trust breakdown). This makes a group performance before December 31, 2025 far less likely. Conversely, if they do not appeal (accepting the ruling), it could open a path toward returning to ADOR and resuming activities as NewJeans, making a 2025 performance more plausible. The appeal decision is thus a strong crux: forecasters who disagree on whether NewJeans will perform in 2025 would likely update significantly based on whether the appeal is filed.

question: Will Phantom daily builder revenue hit $300k in 2025?
description:
This market will resolve to "Yes" if Phantom's daily builder revenue is equal to or greater than the value specified in the title on any day by December 31, 2025. Otherwise, this market will resolve to "No".

The resolution source for this market is Flowscan, specifically the "Daily Revenue by Builder" bar chart set on "30D" available at https://www.flowscan.xyz/builders?builder=all

This market will resolve once any daily total revenue for Phantom is equal to or greater than the value specified in the title, or once the bar for "31 Dec 2025" is finalized and no bar within the timeframe has been equal to or greater than that value.

The value displayed when hovering over the bar for "Dec 31, 2025" will be considered finalized once any bar for January 1 is published.

subquestions.question: Will Phantom's daily builder revenue exceed $150k on any single day between October 31 and November 30, 2025, as shown on Flowscan?
subquestions.background_information:
Phantom is a popular multi-chain crypto wallet, primarily known for its Solana ecosystem presence, that generates revenue through in-app swaps, transaction fees, and other builder-related activity. On Flowscan's 'Daily Revenue by Builder' chart (https://www.flowscan.xyz/builders?builder=all), Phantom's daily revenue fluctuates significantly based on overall crypto market activity and Solana network usage. During periods of high Solana trading volume and memecoin activity, Phantom's daily revenue can spike substantially. The ultimate question asks whether Phantom will hit $300k in daily builder revenue at any point in 2025. Historically, Phantom's revenue tends to correlate strongly with Solana DEX trading volume and memecoin frenzy periods. If Phantom can reach the $150k threshold — half of the $300k target — during November 2025, it would signal that the wallet's revenue generation capacity is in a range where a further spike (e.g., driven by a major market rally or memecoin event) could plausibly push it to $300k before year-end. Conversely, if Phantom's daily revenue remains well below $150k throughout November, achieving $300k in December becomes significantly less likely without an extraordinary catalyst. Solana's network activity and DEX volumes can be tracked via DeFiLlama (https://defillama.com/chain/Solana) and Flowscan (https://www.flowscan.xyz/builders?builder=all).

Sources:
- Flowscan Builder Revenue Dashboard: https://www.flowscan.xyz/builders?builder=all
- DeFiLlama Solana Chain Data: https://defillama.com/chain/Solana
- Phantom Wallet: https://phantom.app/
subquestions.resolution_criteria: This question resolves Yes if, on any day between October 31, 2025 and November 30, 2025 (inclusive), the 'Daily Revenue by Builder' bar chart on Flowscan (https://www.flowscan.xyz/builders?builder=all) shows Phantom's daily revenue at $150,000 or greater. The value is determined by hovering over the relevant daily bar for Phantom in the chart set to '30D' view. The question resolves No if no single day within this window shows Phantom daily revenue of $150,000 or more. The November 30 bar is considered finalized once a December 1 bar is published on Flowscan. If Flowscan is unavailable or ceases to publish this data during the resolution window, the question resolves as ambiguous/unresolvable.
subquestions.rationale: This subquestion serves as a meaningful leading indicator for the ultimate $300k question. Phantom's daily revenue reaching $150k would demonstrate that the wallet's revenue-generating capacity is within striking distance of the $300k target, requiring only a 2x spike during a period of elevated market activity. Crypto revenue tends to be highly volatile and event-driven, so observing the trajectory in November provides crucial information about whether the baseline revenue level and market conditions make a $300k day plausible before year-end. If Phantom cannot reach even $150k during November, it would substantially lower confidence in a $300k day occurring in December. This question measures a different threshold ($150k vs $300k) and thus is not a simple restatement of the ultimate question with an earlier deadline — it asks whether the revenue momentum and market conditions are on a trajectory consistent with the ultimate outcome.

question: Will the next government funding bill be a clean CR?
description:
This market will resolve to "Yes" if the next government funding bill that becomes law in the United States by December 31, 2025, is a clean continuing resolution. Otherwise, the market will resolve to "No."

A clean continuing resolution is defined as a funding measure that temporarily extends current government spending at the previous fiscal year’s levels for a specified period, without incorporating any additional policy provisions, earmarks, or modifications to agency operations.

The primary resolution sources for this market will be a consensus of credible reporting.

subquestions.question: Will the U.S. Senate pass a clean continuing resolution (CR) to reopen the government between October 31, 2025 and November 10, 2025?
subquestions.background_information:
As of late October 2025, the U.S. federal government is in a shutdown. Republicans in the Senate have repeatedly brought up votes on a clean continuing resolution (CR) that would fund the government at current levels through mid-November, but these efforts have failed to gain sufficient bipartisan support. As of October 17, 2025, the Senate had held at least ten votes on a clean CR without success, and lawmakers adjourned without a resolution (Star Local, October 17, 2025: referenced in provided articles). Meanwhile, the shutdown has caused cascading impacts, including threats to community health center funding in Virginia and other states (WSLS, October 21, 2025). The key sticking point appears to be disagreement between parties on whether additional policy provisions or spending changes should be attached to any funding bill. A Senate vote passing a clean CR would be a strong signal that the next government funding bill to become law is indeed a clean CR, as it would indicate bipartisan momentum toward that outcome rather than a more complex omnibus or policy-laden package.

Sources:
- Star Local (Oct 17, 2025): https://starlocalmedia.com/news/no-progress-on-funding-as-trump-cuts-programs-amid-shutdown/
- WSLS (Oct 21, 2025): https://www.wsls.com/news/virginia/2025/10/21/watch-virginia-community-health-centers-face-funding-crisis/
subquestions.resolution_criteria: This question resolves Yes if, between October 31, 2025 and November 10, 2025 (inclusive), the U.S. Senate passes (by a recorded vote or unanimous consent) a standalone clean continuing resolution — defined as a bill that temporarily extends government funding at previously enacted levels for a specified period without incorporating additional policy riders, earmarks, or modifications to agency operations beyond what is necessary to maintain current funding levels. The resolution source will be official Senate roll call vote records available at https://www.senate.gov/legislative/votes_new.htm, supplemented by credible reporting from outlets such as the Associated Press, Reuters, The Washington Post, or The New York Times. If no such vote occurs or the Senate only passes a funding bill that includes substantial policy provisions beyond a simple extension of current funding levels, this question resolves No. If the Senate passes a bill that is ambiguous as to whether it constitutes a 'clean' CR, resolution will rely on a consensus of at least three major credible news outlets characterizing it as a clean CR.
subquestions.rationale: The Senate passing a clean CR is a necessary precursor to a clean CR becoming law. If the Senate cannot pass a clean CR in this window, it becomes much less likely that the next government funding bill signed into law by December 31, 2025 will be a clean CR — either a more complex bill with policy riders will be needed to secure enough votes, or the shutdown will persist longer. Conversely, if the Senate does pass a clean CR, it significantly raises the probability that the House will follow suit and the President will sign it, making it the next government funding bill. This is a direct observable legislative event that serves as a strong leading indicator for the ultimate question.

question: Will Israeli troops enter Suwayda in 2025?
description:
This polymarket will resolve to "Yes" if Israeli military personnel physically enter Suwayda Governorate in Syria for military operations between July 17, and December 31, 2025, 11:59 PM ET. Otherwise, this market will resolve to "No".

For the purposes of this market, aerial and maritime operations will not be considered. Only operations involving troops on the ground within Suwayda Governorate will count.

Undercover Israeli operatives and assets will not count.

The primary resolution source for this market will be photo and video evidence, however a consensus of credible reporting may also be used.

subquestions.question: Will Israel conduct a ground military incursion into Daraa Governorate (which borders Suwayda Governorate) between October 1 and October 31, 2025?
subquestions.background_information:
Israel has been conducting repeated ground incursions into southern Syria throughout 2025, primarily in the Quneitra and Daraa governorates, which border Suwayda. As of late September 2025, Israeli forces have carried out multiple ground operations: on September 28, a 16-vehicle force entered Sida Golan in Quneitra; on September 17, more than 15 vehicles stormed towns in Quneitra; and on September 14, Israeli troops conducted ground operations in southeastern Daraa province (Enab Baladi, September 28, 2025; Yahoo/AP, September 14, 2025). Earlier, on August 29, Israeli forces entered Asha village with 30 vehicles and searched homes (SANA via Enab Baladi). Israel has also conducted airstrikes directly on Suwayda governorate (July 14-16, 2025) and Israeli media have discussed the possibility of a ground or hybrid operation specifically targeting Suwayda (ReliefWeb, July 30, 2025). Daraa governorate is geographically situated between Israel's current zone of ground operations and Suwayda, making continued or expanded ground operations in Daraa a potential precursor or stepping stone to any future entry into Suwayda itself. Israel has demanded a complete demilitarization of southern Syria and has positioned itself as a protector of the Druze community in Suwayda (ReliefWeb, July 21, 2025). Negotiations between Israel and Syria over a security agreement have reportedly stalled over Israel's condition to establish a 'humanitarian corridor' to Suwayda (Enab Baladi, September 28, 2025).

Sources:
- Enab Baladi, 'Quneitra: Israel conducts survey in Sida Golan,' September 28, 2025: https://english.enabbaladi.net/archives/2025/09/quneitra-israel-conducts-survey-in-sida-golan/
- Yahoo/AP, 'Israeli army carries out its latest ground incursion in southern Syria,' September 14, 2025: https://www.yahoo.com/news/israeli-army-carries-latest-ground-incursion-southern-syria-143456789.html
- ReliefWeb, 'Israel Resumes Strikes on Sweida (July 30, 2025),' July 30, 2025: https://reliefweb.int/report/syrian-arab-republic/israel-resumes-strikes-sweida-july-30-2025
- ReliefWeb, 'Expert Comment: Israel's campaign in Syria enters new phase amid al-Suwayda escalation,' July 21, 2025: https://reliefweb.int/report/syrian-arab-republic/expert-comment-israels-campaign-syria-enters-new-phase-amid-al-suwayda-escalation
subquestions.resolution_criteria:
This question resolves Yes if credible reporting (from at least two of the following sources: SANA, Al Jazeera, Reuters, AP, Enab Baladi, or major international news outlets) indicates that Israeli ground forces (troops and/or military vehicles) physically entered Daraa Governorate in Syria between October 1, 2025 and October 31, 2025 (inclusive). Aerial operations (airstrikes, drone flights, reconnaissance overflights) do not count — the incursion must involve personnel or vehicles on the ground within Daraa Governorate. If no such ground incursion is reported by credible sources by October 31, 2025, the question resolves No.

Primary resolution sources:
- SANA (Syrian Arab News Agency): https://sana.sy/en/
- Al Jazeera: https://www.aljazeera.com/
- Enab Baladi: https://english.enabbaladi.net/
- Reuters: https://www.reuters.com/
- AP News: https://apnews.com/
subquestions.rationale: Israeli ground operations in Daraa Governorate are a strong leading indicator for a potential entry into Suwayda. Daraa lies between Israel's current operational zone and Suwayda, and Israel has been progressively expanding its ground operations southward in Syria. Continued or expanded ground operations in Daraa would signal that Israel maintains the operational tempo and willingness to conduct ground incursions deeper into southern Syria, which is a necessary precondition for reaching Suwayda. Additionally, the stalled negotiations over a 'humanitarian corridor' to Suwayda through Daraa suggest that ground operations in Daraa could serve as a prelude to or substitute for a negotiated route to Suwayda. If Israel stops conducting ground operations in Daraa in October, it would suggest a de-escalation that makes entry into the more distant Suwayda less likely by year-end.

question: Israel x Syria security agreement by January 31?
description:
This market will resolve to "Yes" if there is an official security agreement, defined as a publicly announced and mutually agreed deal between the governments of Israel and Syria by January 31, 2026, 11:59 PM ET. Otherwise, this market will resolve to "No".

This market refers only to agreements which directly address border security and demarcation, normalization, or diplomatic recognition or otherwise creates a formalized security framework between the two states.    

Ceasefire announcements or other announced de-escalations such as those relating to the July 16-18 skirmishes with the Druze, or any other future military engagements, which do not address the broader security relationship will not qualify.

Only deals which are officially announced will qualify. Informal announcements which do not constitute a formalized agreement will not count.

The primary resolution source will be official statements from the Israeli and Syrian governments. However, an agreement which is announced by only of the parties will qualify if an overwhelming consensus of credible reporting confirms that such a formal agreement has been reached.

subquestions.question: Will Israel and Syria engage in publicly confirmed, direct or U.S.-mediated face-to-face negotiations (not just 'contacts' or 'channels') between December 12, 2025 and January 11, 2026?
subquestions.background_information:
As of early December 2025, Israel-Syria security negotiations have been ongoing but have repeatedly stalled. Syrian President Ahmed al-Sharaa confirmed in November 2025 that his government is engaged in direct negotiations with Israel, with the U.S. acting as broker (https://www.theyeshivaworld.com/news/israel-news/2317541/syrian-president-confirms-direct-negotiations-with-israel-for-first-time-since-assads-fall.html). Israeli FM Gideon Sa'ar disclosed to the Knesset Foreign Affairs Committee on December 2, 2025 that Israel has been engaged in unofficial, U.S.-facilitated talks with Syria (https://english.almanar.com.lb/2318940). However, a Washington Times report from December 9, 2025 indicated that PM Netanyahu withdrew from a U.S.-brokered agreement at the UN General Assembly in September 2025, halting negotiations (https://www.washingtontimes.com/news/2025/dec/9/netanyahu-behind-stalled-israel-syria-negotiations/). Netanyahu's office denied any final agreement, calling reports 'fake news,' though a Syrian source told Channel 12 that a final draft was nearly complete but paused on Israel's side (https://english.aawsat.com/arab-world/5117581-netanyahu-denies-contacts-syria-have-led-final-agreement). Key sticking points include Israel's insistence on retaining Mount Hermon and establishing a demilitarized buffer zone, versus Syria's demand for full Israeli withdrawal to pre-December 8, 2024 borders. Netanyahu stated on December 4 that a deal is possible only with a buffer zone from Damascus to Mount Hermon (https://www.breitbart.com/middle-east/2025/12/04/netanyahu-says-deal-with-syria-possible-if-security-buffer-zone-included/). The current status is one of stalled but not terminated diplomatic engagement, making the resumption of active, structured negotiations a key precursor to any final agreement.

Sources:
- Al-Manar TV: https://english.almanar.com.lb/2318940
- Washington Times: https://www.washingtontimes.com/news/2025/dec/9/netanyahu-behind-stalled-israel-syria-negotiations/
- Asharq Al-Awsat: https://english.aawsat.com/arab-world/5117581-netanyahu-denies-contacts-syria-have-led-final-agreement
- The Yeshiva World: https://www.theyeshivaworld.com/news/israel-news/2317541/syrian-president-confirms-direct-negotiations-with-israel-for-first-time-since-assads-fall.html
- Breitbart: https://www.breitbart.com/middle-east/2025/12/04/netanyahu-says-deal-with-syria-possible-if-security-buffer-zone-included/
- Al Jazeera: https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2025/11/20/after-israel-pms-trip-to-occupied-syria-is-a-deal-off-the-table
subquestions.resolution_criteria: This question resolves Yes if, between December 12, 2025 and January 11, 2026 (inclusive), credible reporting from at least two major international news outlets (e.g., Reuters, AP, BBC, Al Jazeera, Times of Israel, Washington Post) confirms that Israeli and Syrian officials held structured, face-to-face negotiations — either direct or through a U.S.-mediated format where both delegations were present at the same venue — specifically focused on a security agreement or broader peace framework. The negotiations must be described as formal or structured meetings (not merely indirect 'contacts,' 'channels,' or back-channel communications). Official statements from either the Israeli government, the Syrian government, or the U.S. State Department confirming such meetings also suffice. If no such confirmed meetings are reported by January 11, 2026, this resolves No. Primary resolution sources: Reuters (https://www.reuters.com), AP News (https://apnews.com), Times of Israel (https://www.timesofisrael.com), Al Jazeera (https://www.aljazeera.com).
subquestions.rationale: The resumption of active, structured negotiations is a necessary precondition for reaching a formal security agreement by January 31, 2026. If talks remain stalled through early January — as they appear to have been since September 2025 — it becomes extremely unlikely that a comprehensive agreement could be finalized in the remaining weeks. Conversely, if face-to-face negotiations resume, it signals that key political obstacles (particularly Netanyahu's reluctance and the territorial disagreements) may be resolving, significantly increasing the probability of a deal. This subquestion asks about an observable diplomatic event that is a leading indicator, rather than simply restating the ultimate question with an earlier deadline.

question: Will Trump veto a bill in 2025?
description:
This market will resolve to "Yes" if Donald Trump issues a presidential veto of any bill by December 31, 2025, at 11:59 PM ET. Otherwise, this market will resolve to "No".

The resolution source will be official congressional records and a consensus of credible reporting.

subquestions.question: Will Congress pass a bill to end the government shutdown and send it to President Trump's desk by November 30, 2025?
subquestions.background_information:
The U.S. federal government has been shut down since October 1, 2025, after Congress failed to pass any of the 12 full-year appropriations bills or a stopgap continuing resolution before the fiscal year deadline. As of late October 2025, the shutdown is in its fifth week — the second-longest in U.S. history — with Democrats and Republicans deadlocked over the inclusion of healthcare provisions (such as ACA enhanced premium tax credits) and the scope of spending cuts. President Trump has blamed Democrats for the impasse, while Democrats have demanded that any funding bill address expiring health-insurance subsidies and roll back Medicaid cuts from the 'One Big Beautiful Bill Act.' Prediction markets as of mid-October gave an 84% chance that no funding bill would pass before November 30, 2025 (https://news.yahoo.com/news/congress-won-t-pass-funding-150036498.html). The Senate requires 60 votes to advance most legislation, meaning at least 7 Democrats must join the 53 Republicans. The House's narrow GOP majority means near-unanimous Republican support is also needed. If Congress does pass a funding bill, it would be sent to the President, creating the first major opportunity for Trump to either sign or veto legislation in this Congress. Trump has expressed openness to a clean continuing resolution but has also signaled willingness to use the shutdown as leverage for deeper spending cuts.

Sources:
- ABC13: Senate to reconvene amid funding stalemate (Oct 27, 2025): https://abc13.com/post/government-shutdown-2025-senate-reconvene-monday-funding-stalemate/15617329/
- Yahoo/Polymarket: Congress won't pass funding bill until November (Oct 14, 2025): https://news.yahoo.com/news/congress-won-t-pass-funding-150036498.html
- Epoch Times: Government appears poised to shut down (Sept 30, 2025): https://www.theepochtimes.com/us/government-appears-poised-to-shut-down-amid-partisan-standoff-5765092
subquestions.resolution_criteria: This question resolves Yes if, between 2025-10-31 and 2025-11-30 (inclusive), both chambers of Congress (the U.S. House of Representatives and the U.S. Senate) pass a bill that funds the federal government (whether a continuing resolution, omnibus appropriations bill, or any other funding measure) and that bill is formally presented to the President for signature or veto. The bill must be enrolled and transmitted to the White House; mere passage by one chamber does not count. Resolution will be based on official congressional records available at https://www.congress.gov/ and corroborated by credible news reporting (e.g., AP, Reuters, NYT, Washington Post). If no such bill is presented to the President by 11:59 PM ET on November 30, 2025, the question resolves No.
subquestions.rationale: The government shutdown is the dominant legislative conflict in Congress right now. If Congress manages to pass a funding bill and send it to President Trump, it creates the most plausible scenario for a presidential veto in 2025 — Trump could veto the bill if it contains provisions he opposes (e.g., ACA subsidies, Medicaid rollbacks, or insufficient spending cuts). Conversely, if no bill reaches his desk, there is nothing for him to veto related to this issue. This subquestion tracks whether the legislative precondition for a veto materializes in November, serving as a key early indicator for whether Trump will veto any bill by year-end. It is distinct from the ultimate question because a bill reaching the President's desk could result in either a signature or a veto — but it is a necessary condition for the most likely veto scenario.

question: dogwifhat on the sphere in 2025?
description:
This market will resolve to "Yes" if an advertisement for the cryptocurrency WIF (dogwifhat) is visibly displayed on the exterior of the Las Vegas Sphere by December 31, 2025, 11:59 PM ET. Otherwise, this market will resolve to "No".

The resolution source for this market will be a consensus of credible reporting.

subquestions.question: Will the dogwifhat (WIF) community publicly announce or launch a new crowdfunding campaign specifically to fund a Las Vegas Sphere advertisement between October 31, 2025 and November 30, 2025?
subquestions.background_information:
Dogwifhat (WIF) is a Solana-based meme coin featuring a Shiba Inu dog wearing a knitted hat. The WIF community has a well-documented history of attempting to place the dogwifhat mascot on the Las Vegas Sphere — one of the most iconic digital advertising displays in the world. In late 2023/early 2024, the community crowdfunded over $650,000 in an effort to get the WIF logo displayed on the Sphere (https://decrypt.co/209781/dogwifhat-sphere-las-vegas-ad-solana-memecoin). Despite raising the funds, the advertisement has not yet been confirmed as having appeared on the Sphere. Articles from 2025 continue to reference this crowdfunded effort as an ongoing aspiration (https://bravenewcoin.com/insights/best-crypto-to-buy-as-xrp-amps-up-for-rally-ripples-bank-integration-could-change-everything). As of October 2025, WIF trades around $0.72–$0.77 with a market cap of roughly $720–$800 million. The Sphere's advertising slots are managed by Sphere Entertainment Co. and typically cost millions of dollars for extended campaigns, though shorter placements may be negotiated. A renewed or active fundraising campaign would signal that the community is making a concrete push to secure the advertisement before year-end 2025.

Sources:
- Decrypt: Dogwifhat community crowdfunds for Sphere ad — https://decrypt.co/209781/dogwifhat-sphere-las-vegas-ad-solana-memecoin
- Brave New Coin: Reference to crowdfunded Sphere effort — https://bravenewcoin.com/insights/best-crypto-to-buy-as-xrp-amps-up-for-rally-ripples-bank-integration-could-change-everything
- 99Bitcoins: Dogwifhat overview — https://99bitcoins.com/cryptocurrency/wif-review/
subquestions.resolution_criteria: This question resolves Yes if, between October 31, 2025 and November 30, 2025 (inclusive), there is a credible public announcement — via the official dogwifhat social media accounts (e.g., @dogwifcoin on X/Twitter), a verified GoFundMe/crypto crowdfunding page, or reporting from credible crypto media outlets such as CoinDesk (https://www.coindesk.com), Decrypt (https://decrypt.co), The Block (https://www.theblock.co), or CoinTelegraph (https://cointelegraph.com) — of either (a) a new crowdfunding campaign specifically aimed at funding a dogwifhat advertisement on the Las Vegas Sphere, or (b) an official announcement that previously raised funds are being actively deployed to secure such an advertisement (e.g., a confirmed booking or contract with Sphere Entertainment Co.). The question resolves No if no such announcement or campaign is publicly documented by credible sources by November 30, 2025, 11:59 PM UTC.
subquestions.rationale: The ultimate question asks whether a WIF advertisement will appear on the Las Vegas Sphere by the end of 2025. Given the logistics involved — negotiating with Sphere Entertainment, paying for the ad slot, and scheduling the display — any successful outcome by December 31 would almost certainly require active fundraising, deal-making, or announcements well in advance. If there is no visible campaign activity or public announcement during November 2025, it becomes much less likely that the ad will materialize in the remaining ~30 days of the year. Conversely, an active and well-funded campaign in November would be a strong positive indicator. This subquestion measures a necessary precursor event rather than simply restating the ultimate question with an earlier deadline.

question: Will the Fed Cut–Pause–Pause in the next three decisions (Oct–Dec–Jan)?
description:
The FED interest rates are defined in this market by the upper bound of the target federal funds range. The decisions on the target federal funds range are made by the Federal Open Market Committee (FOMC) meetings.

This market will resolve according to the decisions made by the next three Federal Open Market Committee (FOMC) meetings: October 28–29, 2025; December 9–10, 2025; and January 27–28, 2026.

A qualifying cut occurs when the new upper bound of the target federal funds rate is lower compared to the level it was prior to the respective meeting.

A qualifying hike occurs when the new upper bound of the target federal funds rate is higher compared to the level it was prior to the respective meeting.

A qualifying pause occurs when the new upper bound of the target federal funds rate is equal to the level it was prior to the respective meeting.

If the Fed publishes a different combination than any listed, this market will resolve to "Other".

Emergency rate cuts outside the regularly scheduled meetings will not be considered.

Any rate hike will be encompassed by "Other".

The resolution source for this market is the FOMC’s statement after its meetings:
https://www.federalreserve.gov/monetarypolicy/fomccalendars.htm

The level and change of the target federal funds rate is also published at the official website of the Federal Reserve:
https://www.federalreserve.gov/monetarypolicy/openmarket.htm

subquestions.question: Will the CME FedWatch tool show a probability of 75% or higher for a 25-basis-point rate cut at the October 28–29, 2025 FOMC meeting as of October 27, 2025?
subquestions.background_information:
The ultimate question asks whether the Fed will follow a Cut–Pause–Pause pattern across its next three FOMC meetings (October 28–29, December 9–10, and January 27–28). The first step in that sequence is a 25-basis-point cut at the October meeting. As of mid-September 2025, the CME FedWatch tool showed approximately 93% probability of a 25-bps cut at the October meeting (source: Coingape article from September 17, 2025). The current federal funds target range is 4.00%–4.25% after the September 17, 2025 cut. The CME FedWatch tool aggregates futures-market pricing to derive implied probabilities for each FOMC meeting outcome, and is widely used by economists and traders as a leading indicator of Fed action. If the probability of a cut at the October meeting remains very high on the eve of the meeting, this strongly suggests the first leg of the Cut–Pause–Pause pattern will materialize. Conversely, if market pricing shifts away from a cut (e.g., due to stronger-than-expected inflation data or labor market strength), it would reduce the likelihood of the Cut–Pause–Pause sequence.

Sources:
- CME FedWatch Tool: https://www.cmegroup.com/markets/interest-rates/cme-fedwatch-tool.html
- Coingape, 'FOMC Meeting: Fed Makes First Rate Cut of the Year' (Sept 17, 2025): https://coingape.com/fomc-meeting-fed-makes-first-rate-cut-of-the-year-lowers-rates-by-25-bps/
- Federal Reserve FOMC Calendar: https://www.federalreserve.gov/monetarypolicy/fomccalendars.htm
subquestions.resolution_criteria: This question resolves Yes if, on October 27, 2025 (the business day immediately before the October 28–29 FOMC meeting begins), the CME FedWatch tool (https://www.cmegroup.com/markets/interest-rates/cme-fedwatch-tool.html) shows a probability of 75% or higher for a 25-basis-point cut (i.e., a new target range of 3.75%–4.00%) at the October 28–29, 2025 FOMC meeting. The probability is measured as of the end-of-day snapshot on October 27, 2025. If the CME FedWatch tool is unavailable, the resolution may use the equivalent implied probability from 30-Day Federal Funds Futures contracts on CME as reported by a major financial news outlet (e.g., Reuters, Bloomberg, CNBC). If no reliable data is available by October 31, 2025, the question resolves ambiguously. The resolution window is between 2025-10-01 and 2025-10-31.
subquestions.rationale: The Cut–Pause–Pause sequence requires the October FOMC meeting to deliver a rate cut. Market-implied probabilities from the CME FedWatch tool on the eve of the meeting are the single best predictor of whether that cut will occur. If the probability is high (≥75%), it strongly indicates the first leg of the pattern will materialize, which is a necessary condition for the ultimate question to resolve in favor of Cut–Pause–Pause. If the probability drops below 75%, it signals that economic data (inflation, jobs, tariff effects) released between now and late October have shifted expectations, making Cut–Pause–Pause less likely. This subquestion is measurable before the FOMC decision itself and captures the information environment heading into the meeting.

question: Will TikTok be banned in 2025?
description:
On April 4, 2025, President Trump signed an executive order extending the delay of enforcement of the Protecting Americans from Foreign Adversary Controlled Applications Act, which prohibits TikTok in the United States, until September 17, 2025 (see: https://www.whitehouse.gov/presidential-actions/2025/06/further-extending-the-tiktok-enforcement-delay/)

This market will resolve to "Yes" if a U.S. government ban that prohibits access or use of the TikTok app by the majority of Americans in the United States becomes legally enforceable for any amount of time between July 24, and December 31, 2025, 11:59 PM ET. Otherwise, this market will resolve to "No."

If Trump’s executive order delaying enforcement of the ban expires or is removed without TikTok coming into compliance with U.S. laws and regulations, this market will resolve to “Yes” regardless of whether enforcement action is taken by the U.S. government.

If TikTok is sold to another entity in such a way that it comes into compliance with U.S. laws and regulations this market will resolve to "No".

The primary resolution source for this market will be information from the US federal government, however a consensus of credible reporting will also be used.

subquestions.question: Will President Trump sign an executive order or take other official action to extend the TikTok enforcement deadline beyond September 17, 2025, before September 17, 2025?
subquestions.background_information:
The Protecting Americans from Foreign Adversary Controlled Applications Act requires ByteDance to divest TikTok's U.S. operations or face a ban. The original deadline was January 19, 2025, but President Trump has issued three consecutive executive orders delaying enforcement — first on January 20, then in April, and most recently on June 18, 2025, extending the deadline to September 17, 2025 (https://www.whitehouse.gov/presidential-actions/2025/06/further-extending-the-tiktok-enforcement-delay/). As of late August 2025, no sale or divestiture deal has been finalized. On August 22, 2025, Trump publicly stated he was open to a fourth extension, saying 'we just extend a little bit longer' while buyers are being sought, though he noted a deal would require Chinese government approval that may not come in time (https://www.nytimes.com/2025/08/22/us/politics/trump-tiktok-deadline-extension.html). The White House also launched an official TikTok account on August 19, 2025, further signaling that the administration is not preparing to enforce the ban imminently. Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick has said TikTok would 'go dark' if China did not approve a deal, suggesting the administration views the ban as a real possibility absent a deal but has shown repeated willingness to delay.

Sources:
- White House Executive Order (June 2025): https://www.whitehouse.gov/presidential-actions/2025/06/further-extending-the-tiktok-enforcement-delay/
- Trump open to fourth extension (Aug 22, 2025): https://www.latestly.com/agency-news/world-news-us-extend-tiktok-ban-deadline-again-fourth-delay-6591508.html
- White House joins TikTok (Aug 20, 2025): https://www.aa.com.tr/en/americas/white-house-joins-tiktok-as-president-trumps-deadline-for-potential-ban-gets-closer/3388261
subquestions.resolution_criteria: This question resolves Yes if, between 2025-09-01 and 2025-09-17 (inclusive), President Trump signs an executive order, presidential memorandum, or other official action that extends the enforcement deadline of the Protecting Americans from Foreign Adversary Controlled Applications Act beyond September 17, 2025. The action must be published on the White House website (https://www.whitehouse.gov/presidential-actions/) or announced via official federal government channels. If no such action is taken by 11:59 PM ET on September 17, 2025, this question resolves No. Note: a legislative act by Congress that delays enforcement would also count as Yes. If TikTok is sold or comes into compliance before September 17, rendering an extension moot, and no extension is issued, this question resolves No.
subquestions.rationale: This is the most critical near-term observable event for the ultimate question. If Trump extends the deadline again (a fourth time), TikTok will not be banned on September 17 and the ban becomes less likely for the remainder of 2025, since it establishes a strong pattern of repeated delays. If no extension is issued and no sale is completed, the ban could take effect, making the ultimate question much more likely to resolve Yes. Trump has publicly signaled openness to another extension, but the outcome is not certain — Congress may push back, a deal could materialize, or the administration could allow enforcement. This subquestion directly differentiates between the two main scenarios that drive the ultimate question's resolution.

subquestions.question: Will the MrBeast YouTube channel reach 440 million subscribers by September 30, 2025?
subquestions.background_information:
MrBeast (Jimmy Donaldson) is the most-subscribed individual creator on YouTube. As of late August 2025, various reports cite his subscriber count in the range of 419–425 million. For example, a Sportskeeda article from August 27, 2025 states he has 'over 425 million YouTube subscribers' (https://www.sportskeeda.com/esports/hasanabi-reacts-mrbeast-s-x-post-most-influential-creators-ranking), while a News18 article from August 28, 2025 references '419 million YouTube subscribers' (https://www.news18.com/viral/youtuber-mrbeast-slammed-for-ridiculing-rolling-stone-rankings-after-caleb-hearon-surpasses-him-lvb-9139362.html). MrBeast overtook T-Series as the most-subscribed YouTube channel on June 2, 2024 (https://www.dnaindia.com/). To reach 500 million by December 31, 2025, MrBeast would need to gain roughly 75–80 million subscribers in about four months, or approximately 18–20 million per month. Whether he is on pace for that kind of growth can be gauged by checking if he reaches 440 million by the end of September 2025 — this would imply he gained roughly 15–20 million subscribers in September alone. Historically, MrBeast's growth has been in the range of 5–10 million subscribers per month during 2024-2025, though viral campaigns (like the #TeamWater charity drive in August 2025) and major content releases can produce spikes. Reaching 440 million by end of September would signal an acceleration that makes 500 million by year-end more plausible.

- MrBeast YouTube channel: https://www.youtube.com/@MrBeast

subquestions.resolution_criteria: This question resolves Yes if the MrBeast YouTube channel (https://www.youtube.com/@MrBeast) displays a subscriber count of 440,000,000 or more at any point between 2025-09-01 and 2025-09-30 (inclusive), as verified by the YouTube channel page itself or by third-party tracking services such as Social Blade (https://socialblade.com/youtube/user/mrbeast6000). If the channel page is unavailable, Social Blade or a consensus of at least two credible reporting outlets (e.g., Forbes, The Verge, Dexerto) citing the subscriber milestone will be used. If the subscriber count does not reach 440 million at any point during this window, the question resolves No. If the YouTube subscriber count becomes publicly unavailable due to a platform change and no credible third-party source can confirm the count, the question resolves as ambiguous/No.
subquestions.rationale: To reach 500 million subscribers by December 31, 2025, MrBeast needs to sustain an aggressive growth rate of roughly 18-20 million subscribers per month from his current ~420-425 million base. Checking whether he hits 440 million by end of September is a meaningful near-term indicator of his growth trajectory. If he reaches 440 million (gaining ~15-20M in one month), it signals that he is on a pace consistent with reaching 500M by year-end. If he falls short, the 500M goal becomes significantly less likely under normal growth conditions. This subquestion measures actual growth momentum rather than simply asking the ultimate question with an earlier deadline, since 440M is well below 500M but on the trajectory needed to get there.

question: Will Trump’s approval rating be 44.0–45.9% on December 31?

subquestions.question: Will Trump's approval rating on the Silver Bulletin be below 44.0% at any point between September 12 and October 10, 2025?
subquestions.background_information:

As of early September 2025, the Silver Bulletin shows Trump's approval at approximately 44.1-44.2%, with disapproval at 51.6-51.7% (net approval around -7.4 to -7.6). Conversely, if his approval holds at or above 44.0%, the 44.0-45.9% range remains plausible for December 31. Key factors that could drive near-term movement include economic data (jobs reports, inflation figures), tariff policy developments, and any major news events.

subquestions.resolution_criteria: This question resolves Yes if, at any point between September 12, 2025 and October 10, 2025 (inclusive), the Silver Bulletin's green trend line for Trump's approval rating shows a value below 44.0% (i.e., 43.9% or lower). The resolution source is Silver Bulletin's approval rating poll aggregator at https://www.natesilver.net/p/trump-approval-ratings-nate-silver-bulletin. subquestions.rationale: This subquestion serves as a near-term directional indicator for the ultimate question. Trump's approval currently sits at ~44.1-44.2%, just barely inside the 44.0-45.9% band. If approval drops below 44.0% in the next month, it signals a downward trend that makes it less likely he will be in the 44.0-45.9% range on December 31 (he could be below it). If his approval holds at or above 44.0%, it suggests relative stability in the range that the ultimate question targets. This question captures whether the lower boundary of the target range is at risk of being breached, which is a meaningful crux: forecasters who believe Trump will be in the 44.0-45.9% range on Dec 31 likely believe his approval is stable, while those who believe he won't be in that range might expect further deterioration. The near-term trajectory provides strong evidence for distinguishing these views.

subquestions.question: Will Canadian employment decline by 20,000 or more jobs in the January 2026 Labour Force Survey release (for the December 2025 reference month)?
subquestions.background_information:
The Bank of Canada's March 2026 rate decision will be heavily influenced by labour market conditions. At its December 10, 2025 meeting, the BoC held rates at 2.25% and indicated uncertainty about whether the next move would be a hike or a cut (https://www.marketscreener.com/quote/currency/CANADIAN-DOLLAR-US-DOLL-2392426/news/Bank-of-Canada-can-t-tell-if-next-rate-move-will-be-a-hike-or-a-cut-say-minutes-49345299/). A key factor in previous rate cuts was labour market weakness — Canada lost over 100,000 jobs in two months leading up to the September 2025 cut (https://www.cbc.ca/news/business/bank-of-canada-interest-rate-decision-sept-17-1.7320479), and the unemployment rate climbed to 7.1%. The October 2025 cut was also motivated by a soft labour market (https://finance.yahoo.com/news/bank-canada-considered-waiting-longer-200000399.html). As of the most recent data, the Canadian unemployment rate stands near multi-year highs, and the BoC has signaled that employment is now the binding constraint rather than inflation (https://www.mpamag.com/ca/mortgage-industry/industry-trends/bank-of-canada-to-ease-further-as-fiscal-spending-picks-up-steam/524247). Statistics Canada publishes the Labour Force Survey monthly; the next release covering the December 2025 reference period is expected around January 10, 2026.

Sources:
- Market Screener: BoC December 2025 minutes: https://www.marketscreener.com/quote/currency/CANADIAN-DOLLAR-US-DOLL-2392426/news/Bank-of-Canada-can-t-tell-if-next-rate-move-will-be-a-hike-or-a-cut-say-minutes-49345299/

- MPA Magazine: BoC easing outlook: https://www.mpamag.com/ca/mortgage-industry/industry-trends/bank-of-canada-to-ease-further-as-fiscal-spending-picks-up-steam/524247
- Statistics Canada Labour Force Survey: https://www150.statcan.gc.ca/n1/daily-quotidien/251206/dq251206a-eng.htm
subquestions.resolution_criteria: This question resolves Yes if Statistics Canada's Labour Force Survey release covering the December 2025 reference month (expected around January 10, 2026) reports a net employment decline of 20,000 or more jobs compared to the previous month (November 2025). The resolution window is between 2025-12-24 and 2026-01-23. The primary resolution source is Statistics Canada's official Labour Force Survey release at https://www150.statcan.gc.ca/n1/en/catalogue/71-001-X. If the release is delayed beyond 2026-01-23, this question resolves as ambiguous (N/A). The relevant figure is the month-over-month change in total employment (seasonally adjusted) as reported in the headline release.
subquestions.rationale: Labour market data is one of the most important inputs to the Bank of Canada's rate decisions. Significant job losses in December 2025 would strengthen the case for a 25 bps cut at the March 2026 meeting, as the BoC has explicitly cited employment weakness as a reason for past cuts. Conversely, stable or positive employment would support the BoC's view that the current 2.25% rate is 'about right' and reduce the probability of a March cut. This is a genuine leading indicator rather than a restatement of the ultimate question, and it captures a key crux on which forecasters who disagree about the March decision are likely to diverge.

question: U.S. fertility rate up in Q2 2025?
description:
The CDC reported a general fertility rate of 54.5 births per 1,000 women aged 15–44 for Q1 2025 (see: https://www.cdc.gov/nchs/nvss/vsrr/natality-dashboard.htm). 

This market will resolve to "Yes" if the initial reported rate for Q2 2025 exceeds 54.5, according to the CDC's Vital Statistics Rapid Release series. Otherwise, this market will resolve to "No".
